 1: /**
 2:  * Pure share text and share URL helpers.
 3:  */
 4: 
 5: import { roastUrl } from '../utils/links.js';
 6: 
 7: /**
 8:  * Sanitise one file name part to lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
 9:  * @param {unknown} value Raw value.
10:  * @returns {string} Sanitised part.
11:  */
12: function sanitisePart(value) {
13:   return String(value === undefined || value === null ? '' : value)
14:     .toLowerCase()
15:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_')
16:     .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '');
17: }
18: 
19: /**
20:  * Build the message used by the system share sheet.
21:  * @param {{ headline?: string }} roast Roast data.
22:  * @param {string} url Absolute roast URL.
23:  * @returns {string} Share message.
24:  */
25: export function buildShareText(roast, url) {
26:   const headline = roast && roast.headline ? String(roast.headline) : '';
27:   const link = url === undefined || url === null ? '' : String(url);
28:   return `${headline}\n\nReceipts included. Check them yourself: ${link}`;
29: }
30: 
31: /**
32:  * Build a downloaded PNG file name.
33:  * @param {unknown} clubId Club id.
34:  * @param {unknown} roastId Roast id.
35:  * @param {unknown} formatId Format id such as post or story.
36:  * @returns {string} File name such as roastroom_manutd_roastid_post.png.
37:  */
38: export function buildFileName(clubId, roastId, formatId) {
39:   const club = sanitisePart(clubId) || 'club';
40:   const roast = sanitisePart(roastId) || 'roast';
41:   const format = sanitisePart(formatId) || 'post';
42:   return `roastroom_${club}_${roast}_${format}.png`;
43: }
44: 
45: /**
46:  * Build an absolute roast URL from a base href.
47:  * @param {string} baseHref Page href used as the base.
48:  * @param {string} clubId Club id.
49:  * @param {string} roastId Roast id.
50:  * @returns {string} Absolute URL with the club query and roast hash.
51:  */
52: export function absoluteRoastUrl(baseHref, clubId, roastId) {
53:   const relative = roastUrl(clubId, roastId);
54:   try {
55:     return new URL(relative, baseHref).href;
56:   } catch {
57:     return relative;
58:   }
59: }
60: 
61: /**
62:  * Return the override when set, otherwise the host.
63:  * @param {string} host Current host.
64:  * @param {string} override Host override from shareConfig.
65:  * @returns {string} Host label.
66:  */
67: export function hostLabel(host, override) {
68:   const trimmed = typeof override === 'string' ? override.trim() : '';
69:   if (trimmed.length > 0) return trimmed;
70:   return host === undefined || host === null ? '' : String(host);
71: }

================
File: js/share/textLayout.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Pure text layout helpers. No DOM and no canvas.
  3:  * A measure function is injected so the same logic works in tests and on canvas.
  4:  */
  5: 
  6: /**
  7:  * Wrap text into lines that fit inside maxWidth.
  8:  * Words longer than maxWidth are broken by character.
  9:  * @param {string} text Text to wrap.
 10:  * @param {number} maxWidth Maximum line width.
 11:  * @param {(text: string) => number} measure Function returning the width of a string.
 12:  * @returns {string[]} Wrapped lines. Empty input returns an empty array.
 13:  */
 14: export function wrapText(text, maxWidth, measure) {
 15:   const source = text === undefined || text === null ? '' : String(text);
 16:   if (source.trim().length === 0) return [];
 17: 
 18:   const safeWidth = Number.isFinite(maxWidth) && maxWidth > 0 ? maxWidth : 1;
 19:   if (typeof measure !== 'function') {
 20:     return source.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
 21:   }
 22: 
 23:   const words = source.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
 24:   const lines = [];
 25:   let current = '';
 26: 
 27:   const push = () => {
 28:     if (current.length > 0) {
 29:       lines.push(current);
 30:       current = '';
 31:     }
 32:   };
 33: 
 34:   for (const word of words) {
 35:     if (measure(word) <= safeWidth) {
 36:       if (current.length === 0) {
 37:         current = word;
 38:       } else {
 39:         const candidate = `${current} ${word}`;
 40:         if (measure(candidate) <= safeWidth) {
 41:           current = candidate;
 42:         } else {
 43:           push();
 44:           current = word;
 45:         }
 46:       }
 47:       continue;
 48:     }
 49: 
 50:     push();
 51: 
 52:     for (const char of Array.from(word)) {
 53:       if (current.length === 0) {
 54:         current = char;
 55:       } else if (measure(`${current}${char}`) <= safeWidth) {
 56:         current = `${current}${char}`;
 57:       } else {
 58:         push();
 59:         current = char;
 60:       }
 61:     }
 62:   }
 63: 
 64:   push();
 65:   return lines;
 66: }
 67: 
 68: /**
 69:  * Truncate text to fit inside maxWidth and add an ellipsis.
 70:  * @param {string} text Text to truncate.
 71:  * @param {number} maxWidth Maximum line width.
 72:  * @param {(text: string) => number} measure Function returning the width of a string.
 73:  * @returns {string} The original text when it fits, otherwise a truncated string with an ellipsis.
 74:  */
 75: export function truncateToWidth(text, maxWidth, measure) {
 76:   const source = text === undefined || text === null ? '' : String(text);
 77:   if (source.length === 0) return '';
 78: 
 79:   const safeWidth = Number.isFinite(maxWidth) && maxWidth > 0 ? maxWidth : 0;
 80:   if (safeWidth === 0 || typeof measure !== 'function') return '';
 81: 
 82:   if (measure(source) <= safeWidth) return source;
 83: 
 84:   const ellipsis = '…';
 85:   if (measure(ellipsis) > safeWidth) return '';
 86: 
 87:   let low = 0;
 88:   let high = source.length;
 89: 
 90:   while (low < high) {
 91:     const mid = Math.ceil((low + high) / 2);
 92:     const candidate = `${source.slice(0, mid).trimEnd()}${ellipsis}`;
 93:     if (measure(candidate) <= safeWidth) {
 94:       low = mid;
 95:     } else {
 96:       high = mid - 1;
 97:     }
 98:   }
 99: 
100:   if (low <= 0) return ellipsis;
101:   return `${source.slice(0, low).trimEnd()}${ellipsis}`;
102: }
103: 
104: /**
105:  * Pick the largest font size that fits inside a box.
106:  * @param {{
107:  *   text: string,
108:  *   maxWidth: number,
109:  *   maxHeight: number,
110:  *   maxLines?: number,
111:  *   minFontSize?: number,
112:  *   maxFontSize?: number,
113:  *   step?: number,
114:  *   lineHeightRatio?: number,
115:  *   measure: (text: string, fontSize: number) => number
116:  * }} options Fit options.
117:  * @returns {{ fontSize: number, lines: string[], truncated: boolean }} Fit result.
118:  */
119: export function fitText(options) {
120:   const source =
121:     options && options.text !== undefined && options.text !== null ? String(options.text) : '';
122: 
123:   const minSize =
124:     options && Number.isFinite(options.minFontSize) ? Number(options.minFontSize) : 30;
125:   const maxSize =
126:     options && Number.isFinite(options.maxFontSize) ? Number(options.maxFontSize) : 42;
127:   const sizeStep = options && Number.isFinite(options.step) && options.step > 0 ? options.step : 2;
128:   const safeMaxLines =
129:     options && Number.isFinite(options.maxLines) && options.maxLines > 0
130:       ? Math.floor(options.maxLines)
131:       : 8;
132:   const safeMaxWidth =
133:     options && Number.isFinite(options.maxWidth) && options.maxWidth > 0 ? options.maxWidth : 1;
134:   const safeMaxHeight =
135:     options && Number.isFinite(options.maxHeight) && options.maxHeight > 0
136:       ? options.maxHeight
137:       : Infinity;
138:   const safeLineHeight =
139:     options && Number.isFinite(options.lineHeightRatio) && options.lineHeightRatio > 0
140:       ? options.lineHeightRatio
141:       : 1.35;
142:   const measure = options && typeof options.measure === 'function' ? options.measure : null;
143: 
144:   if (source.trim().length === 0) {
145:     return { fontSize: minSize, lines: [], truncated: false };
146:   }
147: 
148:   if (!measure) {
149:     return { fontSize: minSize, lines: [source], truncated: true };
150:   }
151: 
152:   const topSize = Math.max(minSize, maxSize);
153: 
154:   for (let candidate = topSize; candidate >= minSize; candidate -= sizeStep) {
155:     const lines = wrapText(source, safeMaxWidth, (value) => measure(value, candidate));
156:     const maxByHeight =
157:       safeMaxHeight === Infinity
158:         ? safeMaxLines
159:         : Math.max(1, Math.floor(safeMaxHeight / (candidate * safeLineHeight)));
160:     const allowed = Math.min(safeMaxLines, maxByHeight);
161: 
162:     if (lines.length <= allowed) {
163:       return { fontSize: candidate, lines, truncated: false };
164:     }
165:   }
166: 
167:   const finalSize = minSize;
168:   const finalLines = wrapText(source, safeMaxWidth, (value) => measure(value, finalSize));
169:   const finalMaxByHeight =
170:     safeMaxHeight === Infinity
171:       ? safeMaxLines
172:       : Math.max(1, Math.floor(safeMaxHeight / (finalSize * safeLineHeight)));
173:   const finalAllowed = Math.min(safeMaxLines, finalMaxByHeight);
174: 
175:   if (finalLines.length <= finalAllowed) {
176:     return { fontSize: finalSize, lines: finalLines, truncated: false };
177:   }
178: 
179:   const kept = finalLines.slice(0, Math.max(1, finalAllowed));
180:   const lastIndex = kept.length - 1;
181:   if (lastIndex >= 0) {
182:     kept[lastIndex] = truncateToWidth(`${kept[lastIndex]}…`, safeMaxWidth, (value) =>
183:       measure(value, finalSize)
184:     );
185:   }
186: 
187:   return { fontSize: finalSize, lines: kept, truncated: true };
188: }

================
File: js/ui/categoryFilter.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Builds the category filter chips and reports selection changes.
  3:  * Chips whose category has zero roasts are hidden so the user only sees
  4:  * categories that will actually produce a roast.
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: import { clear, createElement } from '../utils/dom.js';
  8: 
  9: /**
 10:  * Build the filter into a container.
 11:  *
 12:  * @param {{
 13:  *   container: HTMLElement,
 14:  *   categories: Array<{ id: string, displayLabel: string, emoji: string }>,
 15:  *   roasts: Array<{ category: string }>,
 16:  *   selectedId: string,
 17:  *   onChange: (id: string) => void
 18:  * }} options
 19:  * @returns {void}
 20:  */
 21: export function buildCategoryFilter(options) {
 22:   const { container, categories, roasts, selectedId, onChange } = options;
 23: 
 24:   if (!container) return;
 25: 
 26:   clear(container);
 27: 
 28:   const list = Array.isArray(roasts) ? roasts : [];
 29: 
 30:   /** @type {Map<string, number>} */
 31:   const counts = new Map();
 32:   for (const roast of list) {
 33:     const key = String(roast.category);
 34:     counts.set(key, (counts.get(key) || 0) + 1);
 35:   }
 36: 
 37:   const group = createElement('div', {
 38:     className: 'flex flex-wrap gap-2',
 39:     attrs: {
 40:       role: 'group',
 41:       'aria-label': 'Roast category filter',
 42:     },
 43:   });
 44: 
 45:   if (list.length > 0) {
 46:     group.append(
 47:       createChip({
 48:         id: 'all',
 49:         label: 'All',
 50:         count: list.length,
 51:         selected: selectedId === 'all',
 52:         onClick: () => onChange('all'),
 53:       })
 54:     );
 55:   }
 56: 
 57:   if (Array.isArray(categories)) {
 58:     for (const category of categories) {
 59:       const count = counts.get(category.id) || 0;
 60:       if (count === 0) continue;
 61:       group.append(
 62:         createChip({
 63:           id: category.id,
 64:           label: category.displayLabel,
 65:           emoji: category.emoji,
 66:           count,
 67:           selected: selectedId === category.id,
 68:           onClick: () => onChange(category.id),
 69:         })
 70:       );
 71:     }
 72:   }
 73: 
 74:   container.append(group);
 75: }
 76: 
 77: /**
 78:  * Build a single filter chip.
 79:  *
 80:  * @param {{
 81:  *   id: string,
 82:  *   label: string,
 83:  *   emoji?: string,
 84:  *   count: number,
 85:  *   selected: boolean,
 86:  *   onClick: () => void
 87:  * }} options
 88:  * @returns {HTMLButtonElement}
 89:  */
 90: function createChip(options) {
 91:   const { id, label, emoji, count, selected, onClick } = options;
 92: 
 93:   const button = createElement('button', {
 94:     className: 'categoryChip',
 95:     attrs: {
 96:       type: 'button',
 97:       'aria-pressed': selected ? 'true' : 'false',
 98:       'data-category-id': id,
 99:     },
100:   });
101: 
102:   if (emoji) {
103:     button.append(
104:       createElement('span', {
105:         className: 'mr-1',
106:         text: emoji,
107:         attrs: { 'aria-hidden': 'true' },
108:       })
109:     );
110:   }
111: 
112:   button.append(createElement('span', { text: label }));
113:   button.append(
114:     createElement('span', {
115:       className: 'categoryChipCount',
116:       text: `(${count})`,
117:     })
118:   );
119: 
120:   button.addEventListener('click', onClick);
121: 
122:   return button;
123: }

================
File: js/ui/reveal.js
================
 1: /**
 2:  * Reveal animation for a roast card.
 3:  * Runs a short slot machine style reel on the headline, then fades the facts,
 4:  * receipts and verified line in. Under prefers reduced motion everything is
 5:  * skipped and the roast appears immediately.
 6:  */
 7: 
 8: import { prefersReducedMotion } from '../utils/dom.js';
 9: 
10: const REEL_DURATION_MS = 600;
11: const REEL_INTERVAL_MS = 80;
12: 
13: /**
14:  * Reveal a roast inside an already mounted card.
15:  *
16:  * The headline cycles through random entries from the pool for about 600 ms
17:  * with aria hidden set so screen readers do not narrate the churn. When the
18:  * reel settles, the final headline is written, aria hidden is removed, and the
19:  * hidden elements are shown by adding the isVisible class.
20:  *
21:  * @param {{
22:  *   headlineElement: HTMLElement,
23:  *   finalHeadline: string,
24:  *   reelPool: string[],
25:  *   hiddenElements: HTMLElement[]
26:  * }} options
27:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
28:  */
29: export async function revealRoast(options) {
30:   const { headlineElement, finalHeadline, reelPool, hiddenElements } = options;
31: 
32:   if (!headlineElement) return;
33: 
34:   const hidden = Array.isArray(hiddenElements) ? hiddenElements.filter(Boolean) : [];
35:   const pool = Array.isArray(reelPool) ? reelPool : [];
36: 
37:   const finish = () => {
38:     headlineElement.textContent = finalHeadline;
39:     for (const el of hidden) {
40:       el.classList.add('isVisible');
41:     }
42:   };
43: 
44:   if (prefersReducedMotion() || pool.length < 2) {
45:     finish();
46:     return;
47:   }
48: 
49:   headlineElement.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
50:   headlineElement.textContent = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
51: 
52:   const start = Date.now();
53: 
54:   await new Promise((resolve) => {
55:     const tick = () => {
56:       const elapsed = Date.now() - start;
57:       if (elapsed >= REEL_DURATION_MS) {
58:         resolve();
59:         return;
60:       }
61:       const pick = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
62:       headlineElement.textContent = pick;
63:       window.setTimeout(tick, REEL_INTERVAL_MS);
64:     };
65:     tick();
66:   });
67: 
68:   headlineElement.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
69:   finish();
70: }

================
File: js/ui/roastCard.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Builds the DOM for one roast card. Never uses innerHTML with data, so every
  3:  * piece of evidence is inserted as text or as a safe attribute value.
  4:  */
  5: 
  6: import { createElement } from '../utils/dom.js';
  7: 
  8: /**
  9:  * Build a roast card element.
 10:  *
 11:  * The headline is left empty on purpose. The caller decides whether to run the
 12:  * reel and set the final headline, or to set it immediately for a deep link.
 13:  * The facts block, the receipts block and the verified line start hidden and
 14:  * are revealed by the reveal helper.
 15:  *
 16:  * @param {import('../schema.js').Roast} roast Roast data.
 17:  * @param {import('../schema.js').ClubCategory | null} category Category the roast belongs to.
 18:  * @returns {{
 19:  *   element: HTMLElement,
 20:  *   headlineElement: HTMLElement,
 21:  *   hiddenElements: HTMLElement[]
 22:  * }}
 23:  */
 24: export function createRoastCard(roast, category) {
 25:   const card = createElement('article', {
 26:     className: 'roastCard ticketStub',
 27:     attrs: {
 28:       'data-roast-id': roast.id,
 29:       'aria-label': 'Roast',
 30:     },
 31:   });
 32: 
 33:   const categoryLine = createElement('p', {
 34:     className: 'tokenLabel',
 35:     text: category
 36:       ? `${category.emoji}  ${category.displayLabel}`
 37:       : 'Roast',
 38:   });
 39: 
 40:   const jokeLabel = createElement('p', {
 41:     className: 'tokenLabel mt-4',
 42:     text: 'The joke',
 43:   });
 44: 
 45:   const headlineElement = createElement('h2', {
 46:     className: 'roastHeadline mt-2 text-displaySm text-text',
 47:   });
 48: 
 49:   const factsGroup = createElement('div', {
 50:     className: 'revealTarget mt-6',
 51:     attrs: { 'data-reveal-group': 'facts' },
 52:   });
 53:   const factsLabel = createElement('p', { className: 'tokenLabel', text: 'The facts' });
 54:   const factsText = createElement('p', {
 55:     className: 'mt-2 text-base text-text',
 56:     text: roast.explanation,
 57:   });
 58:   factsGroup.append(factsLabel, factsText);
 59: 
 60:   const receiptsGroup = createElement('div', {
 61:     className: 'revealTarget mt-6',
 62:     attrs: { 'data-reveal-group': 'receipts' },
 63:   });
 64:   const receiptsLabel = createElement('p', { className: 'tokenLabel', text: 'The receipts' });
 65:   const receiptsList = createElement('ul', { className: 'mt-3 space-y-3' });
 66: 
 67:   for (const evidence of roast.evidence) {
 68:     const item = createElement('li', {
 69:       className: 'rounded-sharp border border-line bg-surfaceRaised p-3',
 70:     });
 71: 
 72:     const claimEl = createElement('p', {
 73:       className: 'text-sm text-text',
 74:       text: evidence.claim,
 75:     });
 76: 
 77:     const metaEl = createElement('p', {
 78:       className: 'mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-xs text-textMuted',
 79:     });
 80: 
 81:     const periodSpan = createElement('span', { text: `Period ${evidence.period}` });
 82: 
 83:     const sourceLink = createElement('a', {
 84:       className: 'text-accent',
 85:       text: evidence.sourceName,
 86:       attrs: {
 87:         href: evidence.sourceUrl,
 88:         target: '_blank',
 89:         rel: 'noopener noreferrer',
 90:       },
 91:     });
 92: 
 93:     const accessedSpan = createElement('span', {
 94:       text: `Accessed ${evidence.accessedOn}`,
 95:     });
 96: 
 97:     metaEl.append(periodSpan, sourceLink, accessedSpan);
 98:     item.append(claimEl, metaEl);
 99:     receiptsList.append(item);
100:   }
101: 
102:   receiptsGroup.append(receiptsLabel, receiptsList);
103: 
104:   const verifiedEl = createElement('p', {
105:     className: 'revealTarget mt-4 text-xs text-textMuted',
106:     text: `Checked on ${roast.verifiedOn}`,
107:   });
108: 
109:   card.append(categoryLine, jokeLabel, headlineElement, factsGroup, receiptsGroup, verifiedEl);
110: 
111:   return {
112:     element: card,
113:     headlineElement,
114:     hiddenElements: [factsGroup, receiptsGroup, verifiedEl],
115:   };
116: }

================
File: js/ui/shuffleBag.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Shuffle bag used by the roast room.
  3:  * Pure logic, no DOM. rng is injectable so tests stay deterministic.
  4:  *
  5:  * Rules:
  6:  * 1. Every item is served exactly once per cycle before any repeat.
  7:  * 2. When a new cycle starts, the first item differs from the last item
  8:  *    served, whenever the bag holds more than one item.
  9:  * 3. An empty list returns null.
 10:  * 4. A single item returns that item every time.
 11:  */
 12: 
 13: /**
 14:  * @typedef {Object} ShuffleBag
 15:  * @property {() => (T | null)} next Return the next item or null when empty.
 16:  * @property {() => number} remaining Items left before the cycle resets.
 17:  * @property {() => number} size Total items in the bag.
 18:  * @property {(items: T[]) => void} reset Replace the items and reset the cycle.
 19:  * @template T
 20:  */
 21: 
 22: /**
 23:  * Create a shuffle bag.
 24:  * @template T
 25:  * @param {T[]} items Items to serve.
 26:  * @param {() => number} [rng] Random function returning a number in [0, 1).
 27:  * @returns {ShuffleBag<T>}
 28:  */
 29: export function createShuffleBag(items, rng = Math.random) {
 30:   const random = typeof rng === 'function' ? rng : Math.random;
 31: 
 32:   /** @type {T[]} */
 33:   let allItems = [];
 34:   /** @type {T[]} */
 35:   let pool = [];
 36:   /** @type {T | null} */
 37:   let lastServed = null;
 38:   let sizeValue = 0;
 39:   let remainingValue = 0;
 40: 
 41:   /**
 42:    * Fisher-Yates shuffle that leaves the input untouched.
 43:    * @param {T[]} list
 44:    * @returns {T[]}
 45:    */
 46:   function shuffle(list) {
 47:     const copy = list.slice();
 48:     for (let i = copy.length - 1; i > 0; i -= 1) {
 49:       const j = Math.floor(random() * (i + 1));
 50:       const temp = copy[i];
 51:       copy[i] = copy[j];
 52:       copy[j] = temp;
 53:     }
 54:     return copy;
 55:   }
 56: 
 57:   /**
 58:    * Refill the pool from the current items, avoiding a repeat of the last
 59:    * served item when there is more than one item.
 60:    * @returns {void}
 61:    */
 62:   function refill() {
 63:     if (sizeValue === 0) {
 64:       pool = [];
 65:       remainingValue = 0;
 66:       return;
 67:     }
 68: 
 69:     const shuffled = shuffle(allItems);
 70: 
 71:     if (sizeValue > 1 && lastServed !== null && shuffled[0] === lastServed) {
 72:       for (let i = 1; i < shuffled.length; i += 1) {
 73:         if (shuffled[i] !== lastServed) {
 74:           const temp = shuffled[0];
 75:           shuffled[0] = shuffled[i];
 76:           shuffled[i] = temp;
 77:           break;
 78:         }
 79:       }
 80:     }
 81: 
 82:     pool = shuffled;
 83:     remainingValue = pool.length;
 84:   }
 85: 
 86:   /**
 87:    * Replace the items and start a fresh cycle.
 88:    * @param {T[]} newItems
 89:    * @returns {void}
 90:    */
 91:   function reset(newItems) {
 92:     allItems = Array.isArray(newItems) ? newItems.slice() : [];
 93:     sizeValue = allItems.length;
 94:     pool = [];
 95:     lastServed = null;
 96:     remainingValue = sizeValue;
 97:   }
 98: 
 99:   /**
100:    * Serve the next item.
101:    * @returns {T | null}
102:    */
103:   function next() {
104:     if (sizeValue === 0) return null;
105: 
106:     if (pool.length === 0) {
107:       refill();
108:     }
109: 
110:     const item = pool.shift();
111:     remainingValue = pool.length;
112:     lastServed = item === undefined ? null : item;
113:     return item === undefined ? null : item;
114:   }
115: 
116:   /**
117:    * How many items are left in the current cycle.
118:    * @returns {number}
119:    */
120:   function remaining() {
121:     return remainingValue;
122:   }
123: 
124:   /**
125:    * Total number of items in the bag.
126:    * @returns {number}
127:    */
128:   function size() {
129:     return sizeValue;
130:   }
131: 
132:   reset(items);
133: 
134:   return { next, remaining, size, reset };
135: }

================
File: js/utils/dom.js
================
 1: /**
 2:  * Small DOM helpers used across the pages.
 3:  * Never touches innerHTML with data, so nothing user visible can inject markup.
 4:  */
 5: 
 6: /**
 7:  * True when the user has asked the operating system to reduce motion.
 8:  * Returns false in environments without a window, so it is safe to call from
 9:  * any browser entry point without guarding.
10:  * @returns {boolean}
11:  */
12: export function prefersReducedMotion() {
13:   if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof window.matchMedia !== 'function') {
14:     return false;
15:   }
16:   return window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
17: }
18: 
19: /**
20:  * Create an element with a class name, text content, attributes and children,
21:  * all set through safe DOM APIs.
22:  * @param {string} tag HTML tag name.
23:  * @param {{
24:  *   className?: string,
25:  *   text?: string | number,
26:  *   attrs?: Record<string, string | number | undefined | null>,
27:  *   children?: Array<Node | string | null | undefined>
28:  * }} [options]
29:  * @returns {HTMLElement}
30:  */
31: export function createElement(tag, options = {}) {
32:   const element = document.createElement(tag);
33: 
34:   if (typeof options.className === 'string' && options.className.length > 0) {
35:     element.className = options.className;
36:   }
37: 
38:   if (options.text !== undefined && options.text !== null) {
39:     element.textContent = String(options.text);
40:   }
41: 
42:   if (options.attrs && typeof options.attrs === 'object') {
43:     for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(options.attrs)) {
44:       if (value === undefined || value === null) continue;
45:       element.setAttribute(key, String(value));
46:     }
47:   }
48: 
49:   if (Array.isArray(options.children)) {
50:     for (const child of options.children) {
51:       if (child === undefined || child === null) continue;
52:       if (child instanceof Node) {
53:         element.append(child);
54:       } else {
55:         element.append(document.createTextNode(String(child)));
56:       }
57:     }
58:   }
59: 
60:   return element;
61: }
62: 
63: /**
64:  * Set the text content of an element, safely coerced to a string.
65:  * @param {Element | null | undefined} element
66:  * @param {string | number | null | undefined} text
67:  * @returns {void}
68:  */
69: export function setText(element, text) {
70:   if (!element) return;
71:   element.textContent = text === undefined || text === null ? '' : String(text);
72: }
73: 
74: /**
75:  * Remove every child of an element.
76:  * @param {Element | null | undefined} element
77:  * @returns {void}
78:  */
79: export function clear(element) {
80:   if (!element) return;
81:   while (element.firstChild) {
82:     element.removeChild(element.firstChild);
83:   }
84: }

================
File: js/utils/links.js
================
 1: /**
 2:  * URL helpers for deep links between pages.
 3:  */
 4: 
 5: /**
 6:  * Build a stable shareable URL for one roast inside one club.
 7:  * @param {string} clubId Club identifier from the registry.
 8:  * @param {string} roastId Roast identifier, unique inside the club.
 9:  * @returns {string} Relative URL with the club query string and the roast hash.
10:  */
11: export function roastUrl(clubId, roastId) {
12:   const safeClub = encodeURIComponent(String(clubId));
13:   const safeRoast = encodeURIComponent(String(roastId));
14:   return `room.html?club=${safeClub}#${safeRoast}`;
15: }
16: 
17: /**
18:  * Read the roast id from a location hash, ignoring a leading #.
19:  * Returns an empty string when the hash is missing or empty.
20:  * @param {string} hash Value such as "#trophies_last_league_title" or "trophies_last_league_title".
21:  * @returns {string} The decoded roast id, or an empty string.
22:  */
23: export function parseRoastHash(hash) {
24:   if (typeof hash !== 'string') return '';
25:   const raw = hash.startsWith('#') ? hash.slice(1) : hash;
26:   if (raw.length === 0) return '';
27:   try {
28:     return decodeURIComponent(raw);
29:   } catch {
30:     return raw;
31:   }
32: }

================
File: js/registry.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Loads and caches the club registry and club data files.
  3:  * Fetch based loading is for the browser. Node scripts read the same files with
  4:  * fs instead, so the schema and loaders stay browser oriented while the build
  5:  * gate validates files directly.
  6:  */
  7: 
  8: import { CLUB_STATUS, REGISTRY_PATH } from './config.js';
  9: import { validateClub, validateRegistry, validateRoast } from './schema.js';
 10: 
 11: /**
 12:  * Error raised when a data file cannot be fetched, parsed or validated.
 13:  */
 14: export class DataLoadError extends Error {
 15:   /**
 16:    * @param {string} message Human readable summary.
 17:    * @param {{ code?: string, path?: string, errors?: string[] }} [details]
 18:    */
 19:   constructor(message, details = {}) {
 20:     super(message);
 21:     this.name = 'DataLoadError';
 22:     this.code = details.code || 'dataLoadFailed';
 23:     this.path = details.path || '';
 24:     this.errors = Array.isArray(details.errors) ? details.errors : [];
 25:   }
 26: }
 27: 
 28: const registryCache = new Map();
 29: const clubCache = new Map();
 30: 
 31: /**
 32:  * Resolve a site relative path against the site root. js/ sits one level below
 33:  * the root, so ../<path> from this module lands on the path at the root, which
 34:  * means the request no longer depends on the URL of the page that loaded it.
 35:  * @param {string} sitePath Path relative to the site root, such as data/clubs.json.
 36:  * @returns {string} Absolute URL string for fetch.
 37:  */
 38: function resolveSitePath(sitePath) {
 39:   return new URL(`../${sitePath}`, import.meta.url).href;
 40: }
 41: 
 42: /**
 43:  * Fetch a json document and translate every failure into a DataLoadError.
 44:  * @param {string} url Absolute URL to fetch.
 45:  * @param {string} sitePath Logical path used in error messages.
 46:  * @returns {Promise<unknown>}
 47:  */
 48: async function fetchJson(url, sitePath) {
 49:   let response;
 50: 
 51:   try {
 52:     response = await fetch(url, { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
 53:   } catch (error) {
 54:     throw new DataLoadError(`Could not reach ${sitePath}`, {
 55:       code: 'networkError',
 56:       path: sitePath,
 57:       errors: [describe(error)],
 58:     });
 59:   }
 60: 
 61:   if (!response.ok) {
 62:     throw new DataLoadError(`Request for ${sitePath} failed with status ${response.status}`, {
 63:       code: 'httpError',
 64:       path: sitePath,
 65:       errors: [`status ${response.status}`],
 66:     });
 67:   }
 68: 
 69:   try {
 70:     return await response.json();
 71:   } catch (error) {
 72:     throw new DataLoadError(`${sitePath} is not valid JSON`, {
 73:       code: 'parseError',
 74:       path: sitePath,
 75:       errors: [describe(error)],
 76:     });
 77:   }
 78: }
 79: 
 80: /**
 81:  * Turn an unknown thrown value into a readable string.
 82:  * @param {unknown} error
 83:  * @returns {string}
 84:  */
 85: function describe(error) {
 86:   if (error instanceof Error) return error.message;
 87:   return String(error);
 88: }
 89: 
 90: /**
 91:  * Warn about roasts that were dropped by the loader.
 92:  * @param {Array<{ id: string, reasons: string[] }>} dropped
 93:  * @returns {void}
 94:  */
 95: function warnAboutDroppedRoasts(dropped) {
 96:   if (dropped.length === 0) return;
 97:   if (typeof console === 'undefined' || typeof console.warn !== 'function') return;
 98: 
 99:   dropped.forEach((entry) => {
100:     console.warn(`[roastRoom] dropped roast "${entry.id}": ${entry.reasons.join('; ')}`);
101:   });
102: }
103: 
104: /**
105:  * Load and cache the club registry.
106:  * @param {{ path?: string, reload?: boolean }} [options]
107:  * @returns {Promise<{ version: number, clubs: Array<Record<string, unknown>> }>}
108:  * @throws {DataLoadError} When the registry cannot be fetched, parsed or validated.
109:  */
110: export async function loadRegistry(options = {}) {
111:   const path = options.path || REGISTRY_PATH;
112: 
113:   if (options.reload !== true && registryCache.has(path)) {
114:     return registryCache.get(path);
115:   }
116: 
117:   const data = await fetchJson(resolveSitePath(path), path);
118:   const result = validateRegistry(data);
119: 
120:   if (!result.valid) {
121:     throw new DataLoadError(`The club registry at ${path} is not valid`, {
122:       code: 'invalidRegistry',
123:       path,
124:       errors: result.errors,
125:     });
126:   }
127: 
128:   registryCache.set(path, data);
129:   return data;
130: }
131: 
132: /**
133:  * Load and cache one club data file. Roasts that fail validation, or that are
134:  * not verified, are dropped with a console warning instead of failing the page.
135:  * @param {string} clubId Club identifier from the registry.
136:  * @param {{ path?: string, reload?: boolean }} [options]
137:  * @returns {Promise<Record<string, unknown>>} The club data with only publishable roasts.
138:  * @throws {DataLoadError} When the club is unknown, not live, or its data file is broken.
139:  */
140: export async function loadClub(clubId, options = {}) {
141:   const registry = await loadRegistry(options);
142:   const entry = registry.clubs.find((club) => club && club.id === clubId);
143: 
144:   if (!entry) {
145:     throw new DataLoadError(`Club "${clubId}" is not in the registry`, {
146:       code: 'unknownClub',
147:       errors: [`unknown club id "${clubId}"`],
148:     });
149:   }
150: 
151:   if (entry.status !== CLUB_STATUS.LIVE) {
152:     throw new DataLoadError(`Club "${clubId}" is not live yet`, {
153:       code: 'clubNotLive',
154:       errors: [`status is ${entry.status}`],
155:     });
156:   }
157: 
158:   if (typeof entry.dataFile !== 'string' || entry.dataFile.length === 0) {
159:     throw new DataLoadError(`Club "${clubId}" has no data file`, {
160:       code: 'missingDataFile',
161:       errors: ['dataFile is missing from the registry entry'],
162:     });
163:   }
164: 
165:   if (options.reload !== true && clubCache.has(entry.id)) {
166:     return clubCache.get(entry.id);
167:   }
168: 
169:   const data = await fetchJson(resolveSitePath(entry.dataFile), entry.dataFile);
170: 
171:   // Validate the club shell first. Roasts are checked one by one below so that
172:   // a single bad roast cannot take the whole club offline.
173:   const shell = typeof data === 'object' && data !== null ? { ...data, roasts: [] } : data;
174:   const shellResult = validateClub(shell, {
175:     path: entry.dataFile,
176:     mode: 'data',
177:     clubId: entry.id,
178:   });
179: 
180:   if (!shellResult.valid) {
181:     throw new DataLoadError(`${entry.dataFile} is not a valid club data file`, {
182:       code: 'invalidClubData',
183:       path: entry.dataFile,
184:       errors: shellResult.errors,
185:     });
186:   }
187: 
188:   const categoryIds = Array.isArray(data.categories) ? data.categories.map((category) => category.id) : [];
189:   const roasts = Array.isArray(data.roasts) ? data.roasts : [];
190:   const published = [];
191:   const dropped = [];
192:   const seenIds = [];
193: 
194:   roasts.forEach((roast, index) => {
195:     const roastResult = validateRoast(roast, {
196:       path: `roasts[${index}]`,
197:       clubId: data.id,
198:       categoryIds,
199:       seenIds,
200:     });
201: 
202:     const roastId =
203:       roast && typeof roast === 'object' && typeof roast.id === 'string'
204:         ? roast.id
205:         : `roasts[${index}]`;
206: 
207:     if (roastResult.valid) {
208:       published.push(roast);
209:     } else {
210:       dropped.push({ id: roastId, reasons: roastResult.errors });
211:     }
212: 
213:     if (roast && typeof roast === 'object' && typeof roast.id === 'string') {
214:       seenIds.push(roast.id);
215:     }
216:   });
217: 
218:   warnAboutDroppedRoasts(dropped);
219: 
220:   const club = { ...data, roasts: published };
221:   clubCache.set(entry.id, club);
222:   return club;
223: }
224: 
225: /**
226:  * Filter a registry down to the clubs that are live.
227:  * @param {{ clubs?: Array<Record<string, unknown>> }} registry
228:  * @returns {Array<Record<string, unknown>>}
229:  */
230: export function getLiveClubs(registry) {
231:   return getClubsByStatus(registry, CLUB_STATUS.LIVE);
232: }
233: 
234: /**
235:  * Filter a registry down to the clubs that are coming soon.
236:  * @param {{ clubs?: Array<Record<string, unknown>> }} registry
237:  * @returns {Array<Record<string, unknown>>}
238:  */
239: export function getComingSoonClubs(registry) {
240:   return getClubsByStatus(registry, CLUB_STATUS.COMING_SOON).sort((a, b) =>
241:     String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name))
242:   );
243: }
244: 
245: /**
246:  * Shared status filter used by the two exported helpers.
247:  * @param {{ clubs?: Array<Record<string, unknown>> }} registry
248:  * @param {string} status
249:  * @returns {Array<Record<string, unknown>>}
250:  */
251: function getClubsByStatus(registry, status) {
252:   if (!registry || !Array.isArray(registry.clubs)) return [];
253:   return registry.clubs.filter((club) => club && club.status === status);
254: }

================
File: js/schema.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Validation for The Roast Room data files.
  3:  * Every exported validator returns { valid, errors } and never throws.
  4:  */
  5: 
  6: import {
  7:   CATEGORY_IDS,
  8:   CLUB_STATUS,
  9:   LIMITS,
 10:   REGISTRY_VERSION,
 11:   ROAST_ID_PATTERN,
 12:   THEME_KEYS,
 13: } from './config.js';
 14: 
 15: /**
 16:  * @typedef {Object} ValidationResult
 17:  * @property {boolean} valid True when no problems were found.
 18:  * @property {string[]} errors Human readable problem descriptions.
 19:  */
 20: 
 21: /**
 22:  * @typedef {Object} Theme
 23:  * @property {string} primary Hex colour used for club identity and primary fills.
 24:  * @property {string} primaryContrast Hex colour that reads well on top of primary.
 25:  * @property {string} accent Hex colour used for highlights.
 26:  * @property {string} background Page background colour.
 27:  * @property {string} surface Card background colour.
 28:  * @property {string} surfaceRaised Raised panel background colour.
 29:  * @property {string} line Border and divider colour.
 30:  * @property {string} text Default text colour.
 31:  * @property {string} textMuted Secondary text colour.
 32:  */
 33: 
 34: /**
 35:  * @typedef {Object} Evidence
 36:  * @property {string} claim Precise factual statement.
 37:  * @property {string} period Season or date the claim refers to, such as 2013/14 or 2021/09/11.
 38:  * @property {string} sourceName Name of the publication or record.
 39:  * @property {string} sourceUrl Absolute URL starting with https.
 40:  * @property {string} accessedOn Date the source was read, formatted YYYY/MM/DD.
 41:  */
 42: 
 43: /**
 44:  * @typedef {Object} Roast
 45:  * @property {string} id Lowercase identifier, unique inside the club.
 46:  * @property {string} clubId Club the roast belongs to.
 47:  * @property {string} category Category id taken from the club categories.
 48:  * @property {string} headline The joke, 90 characters or fewer.
 49:  * @property {string} explanation Factual context, 280 characters or fewer.
 50:  * @property {Evidence[]} evidence One or more sourced facts.
 51:  * @property {boolean} verified True when a human has checked every claim.
 52:  * @property {string} [verifiedOn] Date of verification, formatted YYYY/MM/DD.
 53:  * @property {string[]} [tags] Optional labels.
 54:  */
 55: 
 56: /**
 57:  * @typedef {Object} ClubCategory
 58:  * @property {string} id Category id from the canonical list.
 59:  * @property {string} displayLabel Label shown in the interface.
 60:  * @property {string} description Short neutral description.
 61:  * @property {string} emoji Single emoji used by the picker.
 62:  */
 63: 
 64: /**
 65:  * @typedef {Object} Club
 66:  * @property {string} id Club identifier.
 67:  * @property {string} name Full club name.
 68:  * @property {string} shortName Short club name.
 69:  * @property {'live' | 'comingSoon'} status Publication status.
 70:  * @property {string} themeKey Key used to tie the club to a theme.
 71:  * @property {string} [dataFile] Path to the club data file, required when live.
 72:  * @property {Theme} [theme] Theme overrides, full in a data file, partial in the registry.
 73:  * @property {ClubCategory[]} [categories] Categories available to the club.
 74:  * @property {Roast[]} [roasts] Roasts belonging to the club.
 75:  */
 76: 
 77: const DATE_PATTERN = /^(\d{4})\/(\d{2})\/(\d{2})$/;
 78: const SEASON_PATTERN = /^\d{4}\/\d{2}$/;
 79: const HEX_COLOR_PATTERN = /^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$/;
 80: 
 81: /**
 82:  * True for a value that is a plain object and not an array.
 83:  * @param {unknown} value
 84:  * @returns {boolean}
 85:  */
 86: function isPlainObject(value) {
 87:   return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
 88: }
 89: 
 90: /**
 91:  * True for a string that contains something other than whitespace.
 92:  * @param {unknown} value
 93:  * @returns {boolean}
 94:  */
 95: function isFilledString(value) {
 96:   return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0;
 97: }
 98: 
 99: /**
100:  * True for a calendar date written as YYYY/MM/DD. The date must actually exist,
101:  * so 2024/02/31 and 2023/02/29 are rejected while 2024/02/29 is accepted. The
102:  * check builds a UTC date and confirms the year, month and day round trip
103:  * unchanged.
104:  * @param {unknown} value
105:  * @returns {boolean}
106:  */
107: function isDateString(value) {
108:   if (typeof value !== 'string') return false;
109:   const match = DATE_PATTERN.exec(value);
110:   if (!match) return false;
111:   const year = Number(match[1]);
112:   const month = Number(match[2]);
113:   const day = Number(match[3]);
114:   const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
115:   return (
116:     date.getUTCFullYear() === year &&
117:     date.getUTCMonth() === month - 1 &&
118:     date.getUTCDate() === day
119:   );
120: }
121: 
122: /**
123:  * True for a season string such as 2013/14 or a full date.
124:  * @param {unknown} value
125:  * @returns {boolean}
126:  */
127: function isPeriodString(value) {
128:   if (typeof value !== 'string') return false;
129:   if (SEASON_PATTERN.test(value)) return true;
130:   return isDateString(value);
131: }
132: 
133: /**
134:  * True for an absolute URL that uses the https scheme.
135:  * @param {unknown} value
136:  * @returns {boolean}
137:  */
138: function isHttpsUrl(value) {
139:   if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.startsWith('https://')) return false;
140:   try {
141:     const url = new URL(value);
142:     return url.protocol === 'https:';
143:   } catch {
144:     return false;
145:   }
146: }
147: 
148: /**
149:  * Validate a theme object. Unknown keys and non hex colours are reported.
150:  * @param {unknown} theme
151:  * @param {{ path?: string, requireAll?: boolean }} [options]
152:  * @returns {ValidationResult}
153:  */
154: function validateTheme(theme, options = {}) {
155:   const path = options.path || 'theme';
156:   const errors = [];
157: 
158:   if (!isPlainObject(theme)) {
159:     return { valid: false, errors: [`${path} must be an object`] };
160:   }
161: 
162:   Object.keys(theme).forEach((key) => {
163:     if (!THEME_KEYS.includes(key)) {
164:       errors.push(`${path}.${key} is not a known theme token`);
165:       return;
166:     }
167:     if (!HEX_COLOR_PATTERN.test(String(theme[key]))) {
168:       errors.push(`${path}.${key} must be a hex colour such as #1C1C1C`);
169:     }
170:   });
171: 
172:   if (options.requireAll === true) {
173:     THEME_KEYS.forEach((key) => {
174:       if (theme[key] === undefined) {
175:         errors.push(`${path}.${key} is required`);
176:       }
177:     });
178:   }
179: 
180:   return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
181: }
182: 
183: /**
184:  * Validate the evidence array attached to a roast.
185:  * @param {unknown} evidence
186:  * @param {{ path?: string }} [options]
187:  * @returns {ValidationResult}
188:  */
189: export function validateEvidence(evidence, options = {}) {
190:   const path = options.path || 'evidence';
191:   const errors = [];
192: 
193:   try {
194:     if (!Array.isArray(evidence)) {
195:       return { valid: false, errors: [`${path} must be an array`] };
196:     }
197: 
198:     if (evidence.length < LIMITS.evidenceMinItems) {
199:       errors.push(`${path} must contain at least ${LIMITS.evidenceMinItems} item`);
200:     }
201: 
202:     evidence.forEach((item, index) => {
203:       const itemPath = `${path}[${index}]`;
204: 
205:       if (!isPlainObject(item)) {
206:         errors.push(`${itemPath} must be an object`);
207:         return;
208:       }
209:       if (!isFilledString(item.claim)) {
210:         errors.push(`${itemPath}.claim must be a non empty string`);
211:       }
212:       if (!isPeriodString(item.period)) {
213:         errors.push(`${itemPath}.period must be a season such as 2013/14 or a date such as 2021/09/11`);
214:       }
215:       if (!isFilledString(item.sourceName)) {
216:         errors.push(`${itemPath}.sourceName must be a non empty string`);
217:       }
218:       if (!isHttpsUrl(item.sourceUrl)) {
219:         errors.push(`${itemPath}.sourceUrl must be an absolute URL starting with https`);
220:       }
221:       if (!isDateString(item.accessedOn)) {
222:         errors.push(`${itemPath}.accessedOn must use the format YYYY/MM/DD and be a real calendar date`);
223:       }
224:     });
225:   } catch {
226:     errors.push(`${path} could not be validated`);
227:   }
228: 
229:   return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
230: }
231: 
232: /**
233:  * Validate a single roast. A roast that is unverified is reported as invalid
234:  * on purpose, because an unverified roast must never reach the page.
235:  * @param {unknown} roast
236:  * @param {Object} [options]
237:  * @param {string} [options.path] Prefix used in error messages.
238:  * @param {string} [options.clubId] Club the roast is expected to belong to.
239:  * @param {string[]} [options.categoryIds] Categories the club exposes.
240:  * @param {string[]} [options.seenIds] Roast ids already used inside the club.
241:  * @returns {ValidationResult}
242:  */
243: export function validateRoast(roast, options = {}) {
244:   const path = options.path || 'roast';
245:   const errors = [];
246: 
247:   try {
248:     if (!isPlainObject(roast)) {
249:       return { valid: false, errors: [`${path} must be an object`] };
250:     }
251: 
252:     if (typeof roast.id !== 'string' || !ROAST_ID_PATTERN.test(roast.id)) {
253:       errors.push(`${path}.id must use lowercase letters, digits and underscores only`);
254:     } else if (roast.id.length < LIMITS.roastIdMinLength || roast.id.length > LIMITS.roastIdMaxLength) {
255:       errors.push(`${path}.id must be between ${LIMITS.roastIdMinLength} and ${LIMITS.roastIdMaxLength} characters`);
256:     } else if (Array.isArray(options.seenIds) && options.seenIds.includes(roast.id)) {
257:       errors.push(`${path}.id "${roast.id}" is already used in this club`);
258:     }
259: 
260:     if (!isFilledString(roast.clubId)) {
261:       errors.push(`${path}.clubId must be a non empty string`);
262:     } else if (isFilledString(options.clubId) && roast.clubId !== options.clubId) {
263:       errors.push(`${path}.clubId must match the club "${options.clubId}"`);
264:     }
265: 
266:     if (!isFilledString(roast.category)) {
267:       errors.push(`${path}.category must be a non empty string`);
268:     } else if (Array.isArray(options.categoryIds) && !options.categoryIds.includes(roast.category)) {
269:       errors.push(`${path}.category "${roast.category}" is not one of the club categories`);
270:     }
271: 
272:     if (!isFilledString(roast.headline)) {
273:       errors.push(`${path}.headline must be a non empty string`);
274:     } else if (roast.headline.trim().length > LIMITS.headlineMaxLength) {
275:       errors.push(`${path}.headline must be ${LIMITS.headlineMaxLength} characters or fewer`);
276:     }
277: 
278:     if (!isFilledString(roast.explanation)) {
279:       errors.push(`${path}.explanation must be a non empty string`);
280:     } else if (roast.explanation.trim().length > LIMITS.explanationMaxLength) {
281:       errors.push(`${path}.explanation must be ${LIMITS.explanationMaxLength} characters or fewer`);
282:     }
283: 
284:     const evidenceResult = validateEvidence(roast.evidence, { path: `${path}.evidence` });
285:     errors.push(...evidenceResult.errors);
286: 
287:     if (roast.verified !== true) {
288:       errors.push(`${path}.verified must be true before a roast can be published`);
289:     } else if (!isDateString(roast.verifiedOn)) {
290:       errors.push(`${path}.verifiedOn must use the format YYYY/MM/DD when verified is true`);
291:     }
292: 
293:     if (roast.tags !== undefined) {
294:       if (!Array.isArray(roast.tags)) {
295:         errors.push(`${path}.tags must be an array when present`);
296:       } else {
297:         roast.tags.forEach((tag, index) => {
298:           if (!isFilledString(tag)) {
299:             errors.push(`${path}.tags[${index}] must be a non empty string`);
300:           } else if (tag.length > LIMITS.tagMaxLength) {
301:             errors.push(`${path}.tags[${index}] must be ${LIMITS.tagMaxLength} characters or fewer`);
302:           }
303:         });
304:       }
305:     }
306:   } catch {
307:     errors.push(`${path} could not be validated`);
308:   }
309: 
310:   return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
311: }
312: 
313: /**
314:  * Validate a club record. The same function covers two shapes:
315:  * a registry entry, which must carry a dataFile when live, and a club data
316:  * file, which must carry theme, categories and roasts.
317:  * @param {unknown} club
318:  * @param {Object} [options]
319:  * @param {string} [options.path] Prefix used in error messages.
320:  * @param {'auto' | 'registry' | 'data'} [options.mode] Shape to expect.
321:  * @param {string} [options.clubId] Club id the record must match.
322:  * @returns {ValidationResult}
323:  */
324: export function validateClub(club, options = {}) {
325:   const path = options.path || 'club';
326:   const mode = options.mode || 'auto';
327:   const errors = [];
328: 
329:   try {
330:     if (!isPlainObject(club)) {
331:       return { valid: false, errors: [`${path} must be an object`] };
332:     }
333: 
334:     const looksLikeDataFile =
335:       isPlainObject(club.theme) || Array.isArray(club.categories) || Array.isArray(club.roasts);
336:     const isDataFile = mode === 'data' || (mode === 'auto' && looksLikeDataFile);
337: 
338:     if (!isFilledString(club.id)) {
339:       errors.push(`${path}.id must be a non empty string`);
340:     } else if (club.id.length > LIMITS.clubIdMaxLength) {
341:       errors.push(`${path}.id must be ${LIMITS.clubIdMaxLength} characters or fewer`);
342:     } else if (isFilledString(options.clubId) && club.id !== options.clubId) {
343:       errors.push(`${path}.id must match the registry club "${options.clubId}"`);
344:     }
345: 
346:     if (!isFilledString(club.name)) {
347:       errors.push(`${path}.name must be a non empty string`);
348:     }
349:     if (!isFilledString(club.shortName)) {
350:       errors.push(`${path}.shortName must be a non empty string`);
351:     }
352:     if (!isFilledString(club.themeKey)) {
353:       errors.push(`${path}.themeKey must be a non empty string`);
354:     }
355: 
356:     if (club.status !== CLUB_STATUS.LIVE && club.status !== CLUB_STATUS.COMING_SOON) {
357:       errors.push(`${path}.status must be "live" or "comingSoon"`);
358:     }
359: 
360:     if (mode !== 'data' && club.status === CLUB_STATUS.LIVE) {
361:       if (!isFilledString(club.dataFile)) {
362:         errors.push(`${path}.dataFile is required when status is live`);
363:       } else if (!club.dataFile.endsWith('.json')) {
364:         errors.push(`${path}.dataFile must point at a json file`);
365:       }
366:     }
367: 
368:     if (isPlainObject(club.theme)) {
369:       const themeResult = validateTheme(club.theme, {
370:         path: `${path}.theme`,
371:         requireAll: isDataFile,
372:       });
373:       errors.push(...themeResult.errors);
374:     } else if (isDataFile) {
375:       errors.push(`${path}.theme is required in a club data file`);
376:     }
377: 
378:     if (isDataFile) {
379:       const categoryIds = [];
380: 
381:       if (!Array.isArray(club.categories)) {
382:         errors.push(`${path}.categories must be an array`);
383:       } else if (club.categories.length === 0) {
384:         errors.push(`${path}.categories must contain at least one category`);
385:       } else {
386:         club.categories.forEach((category, index) => {
387:           const categoryPath = `${path}.categories[${index}]`;
388: 
389:           if (!isPlainObject(category)) {
390:             errors.push(`${categoryPath} must be an object`);
391:             return;
392:           }
393:           if (!isFilledString(category.id)) {
394:             errors.push(`${categoryPath}.id must be a non empty string`);
395:           } else if (!CATEGORY_IDS.includes(category.id)) {
396:             errors.push(`${categoryPath}.id "${category.id}" is not a known category`);
397:           } else if (categoryIds.includes(category.id)) {
398:             errors.push(`${categoryPath}.id "${category.id}" is a duplicate category`);
399:           } else {
400:             categoryIds.push(category.id);
401:           }
402:           if (!isFilledString(category.displayLabel)) {
403:             errors.push(`${categoryPath}.displayLabel must be a non empty string`);
404:           }
405:           if (!isFilledString(category.description)) {
406:             errors.push(`${categoryPath}.description must be a non empty string`);
407:           }
408:           if (!isFilledString(category.emoji)) {
409:             errors.push(`${categoryPath}.emoji must be a non empty string`);
410:           }
411:         });
412:       }
413: 
414:       if (!Array.isArray(club.roasts)) {
415:         errors.push(`${path}.roasts must be an array`);
416:       } else {
417:         const seenIds = [];
418:         club.roasts.forEach((roast, index) => {
419:           const roastResult = validateRoast(roast, {
420:             path: `${path}.roasts[${index}]`,
421:             clubId: club.id,
422:             categoryIds,
423:             seenIds,
424:           });
425:           errors.push(...roastResult.errors);
426:           if (isPlainObject(roast) && typeof roast.id === 'string') {
427:             seenIds.push(roast.id);
428:           }
429:         });
430:       }
431:     }
432:   } catch {
433:     errors.push(`${path} could not be validated`);
434:   }
435: 
436:   return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
437: }
438: 
439: /**
440:  * Validate the whole club registry.
441:  * @param {unknown} registry
442:  * @returns {ValidationResult}
443:  */
444: export function validateRegistry(registry) {
445:   const errors = [];
446: 
447:   try {
448:     if (!isPlainObject(registry)) {
449:       return { valid: false, errors: ['registry must be an object'] };
450:     }
451: 
452:     if (registry.version !== REGISTRY_VERSION) {
453:       errors.push(`registry.version must be ${REGISTRY_VERSION}`);
454:     }
455: 
456:     if (!Array.isArray(registry.clubs)) {
457:       return { valid: false, errors: [...errors, 'registry.clubs must be an array'] };
458:     }
459: 
460:     if (registry.clubs.length === 0) {
461:       errors.push('registry.clubs must contain at least one club');
462:     }
463: 
464:     const seenIds = [];
465:     let liveCount = 0;
466: 
467:     registry.clubs.forEach((club, index) => {
468:       const clubResult = validateClub(club, {
469:         path: `registry.clubs[${index}]`,
470:         mode: 'registry',
471:       });
472:       errors.push(...clubResult.errors);
473: 
474:       if (!isPlainObject(club)) return;
475: 
476:       if (club.status === CLUB_STATUS.LIVE) {
477:         liveCount += 1;
478:       }
479:       if (typeof club.id === 'string') {
480:         if (seenIds.includes(club.id)) {
481:           errors.push(`registry.clubs[${index}].id "${club.id}" is a duplicate club id`);
482:         }
483:         seenIds.push(club.id);
484:       }
485:     });
486: 
487:     if (liveCount === 0) {
488:       errors.push('registry.clubs must contain at least one live club');
489:     }
490:   } catch {
491:     errors.push('registry could not be validated');
492:   }
493: 
494:   return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
495: }

================
File: js/theme.js
================
 1: /**
 2:  * Applies a club theme to the document by writing CSS custom properties on the
 3:  * root element. Every colour in tailwind.config.js reads these variables, so a
 4:  * single call reskins the whole page.
 5:  */
 6: 
 7: import { THEME_VARIABLES } from './config.js';
 8: 
 9: /**
10:  * Find the browser theme colour meta tag and set it.
11:  * @param {string} [value] Colour to apply. Falls back to the background token.
12:  * @returns {void}
13:  */
14: function updateMetaThemeColor(value) {
15:   if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
16:   const meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
17:   if (!meta) return;
18: 
19:   let next = typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : '';
20:   if (next.length === 0) {
21:     next = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--colorBackground').trim();
22:   }
23:   if (next.length > 0) {
24:     meta.setAttribute('content', next);
25:   }
26: }
27: 
28: /**
29:  * Remove every theme custom property from the root element so the defaults in
30:  * css/tokens.css apply again.
31:  * @returns {void}
32:  */
33: function resetThemeProperties() {
34:   if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
35:   const root = document.documentElement;
36:   Object.values(THEME_VARIABLES).forEach((variable) => {
37:     root.style.removeProperty(variable);
38:   });
39: }
40: 
41: /**
42:  * Apply a theme. Every theme custom property is cleared from the root first, so
43:  * a partial theme falls back to the defaults in css/tokens.css for the keys it
44:  * does not set. The provided keys are then applied and the theme colour meta
45:  * tag is updated to match the resulting background.
46:  * @param {Partial<Record<string, string>>} theme Theme keys to apply.
47:  * @returns {void}
48:  */
49: export function applyTheme(theme) {
50:   if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
51:   if (!theme || typeof theme !== 'object') return;
52: 
53:   const root = document.documentElement;
54: 
55:   resetThemeProperties();
56: 
57:   Object.entries(THEME_VARIABLES).forEach(([key, variable]) => {
58:     const value = theme[key];
59:     if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0) {
60:       root.style.setProperty(variable, value.trim());
61:     }
62:   });
63: 
64:   updateMetaThemeColor(theme.background);
65: }
66: 
67: /**
68:  * Remove every inline theme property so the defaults in css/tokens.css apply
69:  * again, and restore the theme colour meta tag.
70:  * @returns {void}
71:  */
72: export function clearTheme() {
73:   if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
74: 
75:   resetThemeProperties();
76:   updateMetaThemeColor();
77: }

================
File: scripts/validate.mjs
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Data gate for The Roast Room.
  3:  * Validates the registry and every club data file, then exits with code 1 when
  4:  * anything is wrong. Run it before every deploy.
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: import { readFile, readdir } from 'node:fs/promises';
  8: import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
  9: import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
 10: 
 11: import { CLUB_STATUS, CLUBS_DIRECTORY, REGISTRY_PATH } from '../js/config.js';
 12: import { validateClub, validateRegistry } from '../js/schema.js';
 13: 
 14: const rootDirectory = resolve(fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url)));
 15: 
 16: /**
 17:  * Turn an unknown thrown value into a readable string.
 18:  * @param {unknown} error
 19:  * @returns {string}
 20:  */
 21: function describeError(error) {
 22:   if (error instanceof Error) return error.message;
 23:   return String(error);
 24: }
 25: 
 26: /**
 27:  * Read and parse a json file relative to the project root.
 28:  * @param {string} relativePath
 29:  * @returns {Promise<unknown>}
 30:  */
 31: async function readJsonFile(relativePath) {
 32:   const absolutePath = join(rootDirectory, relativePath);
 33:   const text = await readFile(absolutePath, 'utf8');
 34:   return JSON.parse(text);
 35: }
 36: 
 37: /**
 38:  * Run every check and collect problems. The process exit code is set by the caller.
 39:  * @returns {Promise<number>} Number of problems found.
 40:  */
 41: async function main() {
 42:   const problems = [];
 43: 
 44:   let registry;
 45:   try {
 46:     registry = await readJsonFile(REGISTRY_PATH);
 47:   } catch (error) {
 48:     console.error(`Could not read ${REGISTRY_PATH}: ${describeError(error)}`);
 49:     return 1;
 50:   }
 51: 
 52:   const registryResult = validateRegistry(registry);
 53:   problems.push(...registryResult.errors);
 54: 
 55:   const clubs = registry && Array.isArray(registry.clubs) ? registry.clubs : [];
 56:   const referencedFiles = new Set();
 57: 
 58:   // Collect every data file that ANY registry club references, whatever its
 59:   // status. A live club must have a readable, valid file. A coming soon club
 60:   // may declare a file that does not exist yet, but the file is validated in
 61:   // exactly the same way as a live club file when it does exist.
 62:   for (const club of clubs) {
 63:     if (!club) continue;
 64:     if (typeof club.dataFile !== 'string' || club.dataFile.length === 0) continue;
 65: 
 66:     referencedFiles.add(club.dataFile);
 67: 
 68:     let data;
 69:     try {
 70:       data = await readJsonFile(club.dataFile);
 71:     } catch (error) {
 72:         const fileIsMissing = error && error.code === 'ENOENT';
 73:         if (club.status === CLUB_STATUS.LIVE || !fileIsMissing) {
 74:           problems.push(`${club.dataFile} could not be read: ${describeError(error)}`);
 75:         }
 76:         continue;
 77:       }
 78: 
 79:     const clubResult = validateClub(data, {
 80:       path: club.dataFile,
 81:       mode: 'data',
 82:       clubId: club.id,
 83:     });
 84:     problems.push(...clubResult.errors);
 85: 
 86:     if (data && typeof data === 'object' && data.themeKey !== club.themeKey) {
 87:       problems.push(`${club.dataFile}.themeKey must match the registry themeKey "${club.themeKey}"`);
 88:     }
 89:   }
 90: 
 91:   let files = [];
 92:   try {
 93:     files = await readdir(join(rootDirectory, CLUBS_DIRECTORY));
 94:   } catch (error) {
 95:     problems.push(`${CLUBS_DIRECTORY} could not be read: ${describeError(error)}`);
 96:   }
 97: 
 98:   // Orphan check. Every file in the clubs folder must be referenced by at
 99:   // least one registry entry, whatever the status of that entry.
100:   for (const file of files) {
101:     if (!file.endsWith('.json')) continue;
102:     const relativePath = `${CLUBS_DIRECTORY}/${file}`;
103:     if (!referencedFiles.has(relativePath)) {
104:       problems.push(`${relativePath} is not referenced by any club in the registry`);
105:     }
106:   }
107: 
108:   if (problems.length > 0) {
109:     console.error(`Data validation failed with ${problems.length} problem(s):`);
110:     for (const problem of problems) {
111:       console.error(`  ${problem}`);
112:     }
113:     return problems.length;
114:   }
115: 
116:   console.log(
117:     `Data validation passed. ${clubs.length} club(s) and ${referencedFiles.size} data file reference(s) checked.`
118:   );
119:   return 0;
120: }
121: 
122: const problemCount = await main();
123: 
124: if (problemCount > 0) {
125:   process.exitCode = 1;
126: }

================
File: tests/fixtures/fakeData.mjs
================
 1: /**
 2:  * FAKE sample data. Used only by tests/schema.test.mjs.
 3:  * Nothing here is loaded by the site and nothing here is a real football fact.

 17: /**
 18:  * Fake measure for single font text.
 19:  * @param {string} text
 20:  * @returns {number}
 21:  */
 22: function fakeMeasure(text) {
 23:   return String(text).length * 10;
 24: }
 25: 
 26: /**
 27:  * Fake measure for fit text.
 28:  * @param {string} text
 29:  * @param {number} fontSize
 30:  * @returns {number}
 31:  */
 32: function fakeFitMeasure(text, fontSize) {
 33:   return String(text).length * fontSize;
 34: }
 35: 
 36: test('wrapText wraps within maxWidth', () => {
 37:   const lines = wrapText('one two three four', 100, fakeMeasure);
 38: 
 39:   assert.ok(lines.length > 1);
 40:   for (const line of lines) {
 41:     assert.ok(fakeMeasure(line) <= 100, `line "${line}" is too wide`);
 42:   }
 43:   assert.equal(lines.join(' '), 'one two three four');
 44: });
 45: 
 46: test('wrapText returns an empty array for empty text', () => {
 47:   assert.deepEqual(wrapText('', 100, fakeMeasure), []);
 48:   assert.deepEqual(wrapText('   ', 100, fakeMeasure), []);
 49: });
 50: 
 51: test('wrapText breaks a single very long word by character', () => {
 52:   const lines = wrapText('abcdefghij', 30, fakeMeasure);
 53: 
 54:   assert.ok(lines.length > 1);
 55:   for (const line of lines) {
 56:     assert.ok(fakeMeasure(line) <= 30, `line "${line}" is too wide`);
 57:   }
 58:   assert.equal(lines.join(''), 'abcdefghij');
 59: });
 60:

 62:   const result = truncateToWidth('abcdefghij', 50, fakeMeasure);
 63: 
 64:   assert.ok(result.endsWith('…'));
 65:   assert.ok(fakeMeasure(result) <= 50);
 66: });
 67: 
 68: test('fitText picks the largest font size that fits', () => {
 69:   const result = fitText({

 71:     maxWidth: 80,
 72:     maxHeight: 200,
 73:     maxLines: 1,
 74:     minFontSize: 10,
 75:     maxFontSize: 20,
 76:     step: 10,
 77:     lineHeightRatio: 1,
 78:     measure: fakeFitMeasure,
 79:   });

 83:   assert.deepEqual(result.lines, ['abcd']);
