================
File: worker/src/index.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Cloudflare Worker entry point for The Roast Room suggestions API.
  3:  * Routing and KV access only. All decisions live in logic.js.
  4:  */
  5: 
  6: import {
  7:   BODY_LIMIT_BYTES,
  8:   BOARD_KEY,
  9:   RATE_LIMIT_HASH_LENGTH,
 10:   RATE_LIMIT_TTL_SECONDS,
 11:   adminView,
 12:   applySuggestion,
 13:   applyVote,
 14:   constantTimeEquals,
 15:   normaliseBoard,
 16:   pickOrigin,
 17:   publicView,
 18: } from './logic.js';
 19: 
 20: /**
 21:  * Build a JSON response with CORS headers only for allowed origins.
 22:  * @param {unknown} body
 23:  * @param {number} status
 24:  * @param {string} origin Allowed origin, or empty string.
 25:  * @param {Record<string, string>} [extraHeaders]
 26:  * @returns {Response}
 27:  */
 28: function jsonResponse(body, status, origin, extraHeaders) {
 29:   const headers = new Headers();
 30:   headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json; charset=utf-8');
 31:   if (origin) {
 32:     headers.set('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', origin);
 33:     headers.set('Vary', 'Origin');
 34:   }
 35:   if (extraHeaders) {
 36:     for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(extraHeaders)) {
 37:       headers.set(key, value);
 38:     }
 39:   }
 40:   return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status, headers });
 41: }
 42: 
 43: /**
 44:  * Build an error response shaped { error, message } with no stack traces.
 45:  * @param {string} code
 46:  * @param {string} message
 47:  * @param {number} status
 48:  * @param {string} origin
 49:  * @returns {Response}
 50:  */
 51: function errorResponse(code, message, status, origin) {
 52:   return jsonResponse({ error: code, message }, status, origin);
 53: }
 54: 
 55: /**
 56:  * Handle a CORS preflight.
 57:  * @param {Request} request
 58:  * @param {string} allowedOrigins
 59:  * @returns {Response}
 60:  */
 61: function handleOptions(request, allowedOrigins) {
 62:   const origin = pickOrigin(request.headers.get('Origin') || '', allowedOrigins);
 63:   const headers = new Headers();
 64:   if (origin) {
 65:     headers.set('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', origin);
 66:     headers.set('Vary', 'Origin');
 67:     headers.set('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, OPTIONS');
 68:     headers.set('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type, Authorization');
 69:     headers.set('Access-Control-Max-Age', '600');
 70:   }
 71:   return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers });
 72: }
 73: 
 74: /**
 75:  * Hash a client identifier with the salt and truncate to 32 hex characters.
 76:  * @param {string} clientIp
 77:  * @param {string} salt
 78:  * @returns {Promise<string>}
 79:  */
 80: async function hashClient(clientIp, salt) {
 81:   const data = new TextEncoder().encode(`${salt}${clientIp}`);
 82:   const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data);
 83:   const bytes = new Uint8Array(digest);
 84:   let hex = '';
 85:   for (const byte of bytes) hex += byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
 86:   return hex.slice(0, RATE_LIMIT_HASH_LENGTH);
 87: }
 88: 
 89: /**
 90:  * Build a UTC day string in the YYYYMMDD shape used in the rate key.
 91:  * @param {Date} date
 92:  * @returns {string}
 93:  */
 94: function utcDay(date) {
 95:   const year = date.getUTCFullYear();
 96:   const month = String(date.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
 97:   const day = String(date.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, '0');
 98:   return `${year}${month}${day}`;
 99: }
100: 
101: /**
102:  * Read the request body as a JSON object, enforcing the size limit and the
103:  * content type. The body check uses byte length, not character count.
104:  * @param {Request} request
105:  * @returns {Promise<{ ok: true, data: Record<string, unknown> } | { ok: false, error: string, status: number }>}
106:  */
107: async function readJsonBody(request) {
108:   const contentType = (request.headers.get('Content-Type') || '').toLowerCase();
109:   if (!contentType.includes('application/json')) {
110:     return { ok: false, error: 'unsupportedMediaType', status: 415 };
111:   }
112:   const text = await request.text();
113:   if (new TextEncoder().encode(text).length > BODY_LIMIT_BYTES) {
114:     return { ok: false, error: 'bodyTooLarge', status: 400 };
115:   }
116:   try {
117:     const data = JSON.parse(text);
118:     if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data)) {
119:       return { ok: false, error: 'invalidBody', status: 400 };
120:     }
121:     return { ok: true, data };
122:   } catch {
123:     return { ok: false, error: 'invalidBody', status: 400 };
124:   }
125: }
126: 
127: /**
128:  * Check the admin bearer token against the configured secret in constant time.
129:  * An unset ADMIN_TOKEN rejects every admin request.
130:  * @param {Request} request
131:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
132:  * @returns {boolean}
133:  */
134: function checkAdmin(request, env) {
135:   const configured = env && typeof env.ADMIN_TOKEN === 'string' ? env.ADMIN_TOKEN : '';
136:   if (configured.length === 0) return false;
137:   const auth = request.headers.get('Authorization') || '';
138:   return constantTimeEquals(auth, `Bearer ${configured}`);
139: }
140: 
141: /**
142:  * Read the rate record for a request client.
143:  * @param {Request} request
144:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
145:  * @returns {Promise<{ key: string, record: unknown }>}
146:  */
147: async function readRate(request, env) {
148:   const clientIp = request.headers.get('CF-Connecting-IP') || 'unknown';
149:   const salt = typeof env.HASH_SALT === 'string' ? env.HASH_SALT : '';
150:   const hash = await hashClient(clientIp, salt);
151:   const key = `rl:${hash}:${utcDay(new Date())}`;
152:   const record = await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(key, 'json');
153:   return { key, record };
154: }
155: 
156: /**
157:  * Persist an accepted action. Exactly two writes: rate record then board.
158:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
159:  * @param {string} rateKey
160:  * @param {unknown} rateRecord
161:  * @param {unknown} board
162:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
163:  */
164: async function persist(env, rateKey, rateRecord, board) {
165:   await env.SUGGESTIONS.put(rateKey, JSON.stringify(rateRecord), {
166:     expirationTtl: RATE_LIMIT_TTL_SECONDS,
167:   });
168:   await env.SUGGESTIONS.put(BOARD_KEY, JSON.stringify(board));
169: }
170: 
171: /**
172:  * GET /api/suggestions.
173:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
174:  * @param {string} origin
175:  * @returns {Promise<Response>}
176:  */
177: async function handleListSuggestions(env, origin) {
178:   const board = await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(BOARD_KEY, 'json');
179:   return jsonResponse(publicView(board), 200, origin, {
180:     'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=30',
181:   });
182: }
183: 
184: /**
185:  * POST /api/suggestions.
186:  * @param {Request} request
187:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
188:  * @param {string} origin
189:  * @returns {Promise<Response>}
190:  */
191: async function handlePostSuggestion(request, env, origin) {
192:   const bodyResult = await readJsonBody(request);
193:   if (!bodyResult.ok) {
194:     return errorResponse(bodyResult.error, 'That request could not be read.', bodyResult.status, origin);
195:   }
196:   const { name, website } = bodyResult.data;
197: 
198:   // Honeypot: pretend success and write nothing.
199:   if (typeof website === 'string' && website.trim().length > 0) {
200:     return jsonResponse(
201:       { status: 'pending', message: 'Thanks, your suggestion will appear after review.' },
202:       200,
203:       origin
204:     );
205:   }
206: 
207:   const { key: rateKey, record: rateRecord } = await readRate(request, env);
208:   const board = await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(BOARD_KEY, 'json');
209:   const now = new Date().toISOString();
210:   const result = applySuggestion({ board, name, rateRecord, now });
211: 
212:   if (result.outcome === 'invalid') {
213:     return errorResponse('invalidName', result.errors.join('; '), 400, origin);
214:   }
215:   if (result.outcome === 'rateLimited') {
216:     return errorResponse('rateLimited', result.errors.join('; '), 429, origin);
217:   }
218:   if (result.outcome === 'full') {
219:     return jsonResponse(
220:       {
221:         status: 'pending',
222:         message: 'The suggestion list is full right now. Try again later.',
223:       },
224:       200,
225:       origin
226:     );
227:   }
228: 
229:   await persist(env, rateKey, result.rateRecord, result.board);
230: 
231:   if (result.outcome === 'voted') {
232:     return jsonResponse(
233:       { status: 'voted', message: 'That club is already on the list. Your vote was added.' },
234:       200,
235:       origin
236:     );
237:   }
238:   return jsonResponse(
239:     { status: 'pending', message: 'Thanks, your suggestion will appear after review.' },
240:     200,
241:     origin
242:   );
243: }
244: 
245: /**
246:  * POST /api/votes.
247:  * @param {Request} request
248:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
249:  * @param {string} origin
250:  * @returns {Promise<Response>}
251:  */
252: async function handlePostVote(request, env, origin) {
253:   const bodyResult = await readJsonBody(request);
254:   if (!bodyResult.ok) {
255:     return errorResponse(bodyResult.error, 'That request could not be read.', bodyResult.status, origin);
256:   }
257:   const { slug } = bodyResult.data;
258: 
259:   const { key: rateKey, record: rateRecord } = await readRate(request, env);
260:   const board = await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(BOARD_KEY, 'json');
261:   const now = new Date().toISOString();
262:   const result = applyVote({ board, slug, rateRecord, now });
263: 
264:   if (result.outcome === 'notFound' || result.outcome === 'notApproved') {
265:     return errorResponse('notFound', 'That suggestion is not available.', 404, origin);
266:   }
267:   if (result.outcome === 'rateLimited') {
268:     return errorResponse('rateLimited', result.errors.join('; '), 429, origin);
269:   }
270: 
271:   await persist(env, rateKey, result.rateRecord, result.board);
272:   return jsonResponse({ status: 'voted', message: 'Your vote was added.' }, 200, origin);
273: }
274: 
275: /**
276:  * GET /api/admin/suggestions.
277:  * @param {Request} request
278:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
279:  * @param {string} origin
280:  * @returns {Promise<Response>}
281:  */
282: async function handleAdminList(request, env, origin) {
283:   if (!checkAdmin(request, env)) {
284:     return errorResponse('unauthorized', 'Not authorized.', 401, origin);
285:   }
286:   const board = await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(BOARD_KEY, 'json');
287:   return jsonResponse(adminView(board), 200, origin);
288: }
289: 
290: /**
291:  * POST /api/admin/approve.
292:  * @param {Request} request
293:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
294:  * @param {string} origin
295:  * @returns {Promise<Response>}
296:  */
297: async function handleAdminApprove(request, env, origin) {
298:   if (!checkAdmin(request, env)) {
299:     return errorResponse('unauthorized', 'Not authorized.', 401, origin);
300:   }
301:   const bodyResult = await readJsonBody(request);
302:   if (!bodyResult.ok) {
303:     return errorResponse(bodyResult.error, 'That request could not be read.', bodyResult.status, origin);
304:   }
305:   const { slug, approved } = bodyResult.data;
306:   if (typeof slug !== 'string' || typeof approved !== 'boolean') {
307:     return errorResponse('invalidBody', 'slug and approved are required.', 400, origin);
308:   }
309:   const board = normaliseBoard(await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(BOARD_KEY, 'json'));
310:   const existing = board.suggestions[slug];
311:   if (!existing) {
312:     return errorResponse('notFound', 'That suggestion is not in the board.', 404, origin);
313:   }
314:   const next = {
315:     version: board.version,
316:     suggestions: {
317:       ...board.suggestions,
318:       [slug]: { ...existing, approved, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() },
319:     },
320:   };
321:   await env.SUGGESTIONS.put(BOARD_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
322:   return jsonResponse({ slug, approved }, 200, origin);
323: }
324: 
325: /**
326:  * POST /api/admin/remove.
327:  * @param {Request} request
328:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
329:  * @param {string} origin
330:  * @returns {Promise<Response>}
331:  */
332: async function handleAdminRemove(request, env, origin) {
333:   if (!checkAdmin(request, env)) {
334:     return errorResponse('unauthorized', 'Not authorized.', 401, origin);
335:   }
336:   const bodyResult = await readJsonBody(request);
337:   if (!bodyResult.ok) {
338:     return errorResponse(bodyResult.error, 'That request could not be read.', bodyResult.status, origin);
339:   }
340:   const { slug } = bodyResult.data;
341:   if (typeof slug !== 'string') {
342:     return errorResponse('invalidBody', 'slug is required.', 400, origin);
343:   }
344:   const board = normaliseBoard(await env.SUGGESTIONS.get(BOARD_KEY, 'json'));
345:   if (!board.suggestions[slug]) {
346:     return errorResponse('notFound', 'That suggestion is not in the board.', 404, origin);
347:   }
348:   const next = {
349:     version: board.version,
350:     suggestions: { ...board.suggestions },
351:   };
352:   delete next.suggestions[slug];
353:   await env.SUGGESTIONS.put(BOARD_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
354:   return jsonResponse({ slug, removed: true }, 200, origin);
355: }
356: 
357: export default {
358:   /**
359:    * Worker entry point.
360:    * @param {Request} request
361:    * @param {Record<string, unknown>} env
362:    * @returns {Promise<Response>}
363:    */
364:   async fetch(request, env) {
365:     const url = new URL(request.url);
366:     const allowedOrigins = typeof env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS === 'string' ? env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS : '';
367:     const origin = pickOrigin(request.headers.get('Origin') || '', allowedOrigins);
368: 
369:     if (request.method === 'OPTIONS') {
370:       return handleOptions(request, allowedOrigins);
371:     }
372: 
373:     const isPost = request.method === 'POST';
374:     const hasOriginHeader = request.headers.get('Origin') !== null;
375:     if (isPost && hasOriginHeader && !origin) {
376:       return errorResponse('originNotAllowed', 'This origin is not allowed.', 403, '');
377:     }
378: 
379:     const path = url.pathname;
380: 
381:     if (path === '/api/suggestions' && request.method === 'GET') {
382:       return handleListSuggestions(env, origin);
383:     }
384:     if (path === '/api/suggestions' && request.method === 'POST') {
385:       return handlePostSuggestion(request, env, origin);
386:     }
387:     if (path === '/api/votes' && request.method === 'POST') {
388:       return handlePostVote(request, env, origin);
389:     }
390:     if (path === '/api/admin/suggestions' && request.method === 'GET') {
391:       return handleAdminList(request, env, origin);
392:     }
393:     if (path === '/api/admin/approve' && request.method === 'POST') {
394:       return handleAdminApprove(request, env, origin);
395:     }
396:     if (path === '/api/admin/remove' && request.method === 'POST') {
397:       return handleAdminRemove(request, env, origin);
398:     }
399: 
400:     return errorResponse('notFound', 'That route does not exist.', 404, origin);
401:   },
402: };

================
File: worker/src/logic.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Pure logic for The Roast Room suggestions Worker.
  3:  * No Cloudflare APIs, no fetch, no KV. Everything here runs unchanged in the
  4:  * Worker and in the Node test runner.
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: export const BOARD_KEY = 'board';
  8: export const BOARD_VERSION = 1;
  9: export const MAX_SUGGESTIONS = 300;
 10: export const RATE_LIMIT_ACTIONS_PER_DAY = 6;
 11: export const RATE_LIMIT_TTL_SECONDS = 172800;
 12: export const RATE_LIMIT_HASH_LENGTH = 32;
 13: export const NAME_MIN_LENGTH = 2;
 14: export const NAME_MAX_LENGTH = 40;
 15: export const BODY_LIMIT_BYTES = 2048;
 16: 
 17: /**
 18:  * Normalise a raw club name. Trim and collapse runs of whitespace to a single
 19:  * space. Anything that is not a string becomes an empty string.
 20:  * @param {unknown} raw
 21:  * @returns {string}
 22:  */
 23: export function normaliseName(raw) {
 24:   if (typeof raw !== 'string') return '';
 25:   return raw.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
 26: }
 27: 
 28: /**
 29:  * Validate a club name against the published rules.
 30:  * Allowed characters are letters in any language, digits, spaces, apostrophe,
 31:  * full stop and ampersand. Urls, the at sign and digits only are rejected.
 32:  * @param {unknown} raw
 33:  * @returns {{ valid: boolean, errors: string[], name: string }}
 34:  */
 35: export function validateName(raw) {
 36:   const name = normaliseName(raw);
 37:   const errors = [];
 38: 
 39:   if (name.length < NAME_MIN_LENGTH) {
 40:     errors.push(`name must be at least ${NAME_MIN_LENGTH} characters`);
 41:   }
 42:   if (name.length > NAME_MAX_LENGTH) {
 43:     errors.push(`name must be ${NAME_MAX_LENGTH} characters or fewer`);
 44:   }
 45: 
 46:   const lower = name.toLowerCase();
 47:   if (lower.includes('http')) errors.push('name cannot contain a url');
 48:   if (lower.includes('www')) errors.push('name cannot contain a url');
 49:   if (name.includes('@')) errors.push('name cannot contain an at sign');
 50:   if (name.length > 0 && /^[0-9]+$/.test(name)) {
 51:     errors.push('name cannot be digits only');
 52:   }
 53:   if (name.length > 0 && !/^[\p{L}0-9 .'&]+$/u.test(name)) {
 54:     errors.push('name contains disallowed characters');
 55:   }
 56: 
 57:   return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors, name };
 58: }
 59: 
 60: /**
 61:  * Slugify a normalised name. Output is lowercase a to z, digits and
 62:  * underscores only. Accented letters are stripped of diacritics first so
 63:  * Atlético becomes atletico. Anything that cannot be turned into a slug
 64:  * becomes an empty string, which the caller treats as a validation error.
 65:  * @param {unknown} name
 66:  * @returns {string}
 67:  */
 68: export function slugify(name) {
 69:   return String(name === undefined || name === null ? '' : name)
 70:     .normalize('NFD')
 71:     .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
 72:     .toLowerCase()
 73:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_')
 74:     .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '');
 75: }
 76: 
 77: /**
 78:  * Read a rate record safely. Missing or malformed records become empty.
 79:  * @param {unknown} record
 80:  * @returns {{ actions: number, voted: string[] }}
 81:  */
 82: export function normaliseRateRecord(record) {
 83:   if (!record || typeof record !== 'object') {
 84:     return { actions: 0, voted: [] };
 85:   }
 86:   const actions = Number.isInteger(record.actions) && record.actions >= 0 ? record.actions : 0;
 87:   const voted = Array.isArray(record.voted)
 88:     ? record.voted.filter((entry) => typeof entry === 'string')
 89:     : [];
 90:   return { actions, voted };
 91: }
 92: 
 93: /**
 94:  * Read a board safely. Missing or malformed boards become empty boards.
 95:  * @param {unknown} board
 96:  * @returns {{ version: number, suggestions: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> }}
 97:  */
 98: export function normaliseBoard(board) {
 99:   if (
100:     !board ||
101:     typeof board !== 'object' ||
102:     !board.suggestions ||
103:     typeof board.suggestions !== 'object' ||
104:     Array.isArray(board.suggestions)
105:   ) {
106:     return { version: BOARD_VERSION, suggestions: {} };
107:   }
108:   return { version: BOARD_VERSION, suggestions: board.suggestions };
109: }
110: 
111: /**
112:  * Count the suggestions in a board.
113:  * @param {unknown} board
114:  * @returns {number}
115:  */
116: export function countSuggestions(board) {
117:   return Object.keys(normaliseBoard(board).suggestions).length;
118: }
119: 
120: /**
121:  * Decide whether a client can perform another action today.
122:  * @param {{ actions: number }} record
123:  * @returns {{ allowed: boolean, reason: string }}
124:  */
125: export function canAct(record) {
126:   const safe = normaliseRateRecord(record);
127:   if (safe.actions >= RATE_LIMIT_ACTIONS_PER_DAY) {
128:     return { allowed: false, reason: 'rateLimited' };
129:   }
130:   return { allowed: true, reason: 'ok' };
131: }
132: 
133: /**
134:  * Decide whether a client can vote for a slug today.
135:  * @param {{ voted: string[] }} record
136:  * @param {string} slug
137:  * @returns {{ allowed: boolean, reason: string }}
138:  */
139: export function canVote(record, slug) {
140:   const safe = normaliseRateRecord(record);
141:   if (safe.voted.includes(slug)) {
142:     return { allowed: false, reason: 'alreadyVoted' };
143:   }
144:   return { allowed: true, reason: 'ok' };
145: }
146: 
147: /**
148:  * Apply a suggestion. A slug that already exists merges into a vote on the
149:  * existing record. A brand new slug creates a pending suggestion and counts
150:  * the submitter as the first vote. Returns the new board and rate record so
151:  * the caller can perform exactly two KV writes when the outcome is accepted.
152:  * @param {{
153:  *   board: unknown,
154:  *   name: unknown,
155:  *   rateRecord: unknown,
156:  *   now: string
157:  * }} options
158:  * @returns {{
159:  *   outcome: 'voted' | 'pending' | 'full' | 'invalid' | 'rateLimited',
160:  *   board: { version: number, suggestions: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> },
161:  *   rateRecord: { actions: number, voted: string[] },
162:  *   slug: string,
163:  *   errors: string[]
164:  * }}
165:  */
166: export function applySuggestion(options) {
167:   const { board, name, rateRecord, now } = options || {};
168:   const safeBoard = normaliseBoard(board);
169:   const safeRate = normaliseRateRecord(rateRecord);
170: 
171:   const validation = validateName(name);
172:   if (!validation.valid) {
173:     return {
174:       outcome: 'invalid',
175:       board: safeBoard,
176:       rateRecord: safeRate,
177:       slug: '',
178:       errors: validation.errors,
179:     };
180:   }
181: 
182:   const slug = slugify(validation.name);
183:   if (!slug) {
184:     return {
185:       outcome: 'invalid',
186:       board: safeBoard,
187:       rateRecord: safeRate,
188:       slug: '',
189:       errors: ['name cannot be turned into a slug'],
190:     };
191:   }
192: 
193:   if (!canAct(safeRate).allowed) {
194:     return {
195:       outcome: 'rateLimited',
196:       board: safeBoard,
197:       rateRecord: safeRate,
198:       slug,
199:       errors: ['You have reached the daily limit. Try again tomorrow.'],
200:     };
201:   }
202: 
203:   // Vote path: the slug already exists.
204:   const existing = safeBoard.suggestions[slug];
205:   if (existing) {
206:     if (!canVote(safeRate, slug).allowed) {
207:       return {
208:         outcome: 'rateLimited',
209:         board: safeBoard,
210:         rateRecord: safeRate,
211:         slug,
212:         errors: ['You have already voted for this club today.'],
213:       };
214:     }
215:     const nextBoard = {
216:       version: safeBoard.version,
217:       suggestions: {
218:         ...safeBoard.suggestions,
219:         [slug]: {
220:           ...existing,
221:           votes: (Number.isInteger(existing.votes) ? existing.votes : 0) + 1,
222:           updatedAt: now,
223:         },
224:       },
225:     };
226:     const nextRate = {
227:       actions: safeRate.actions + 1,
228:       voted: safeRate.voted.concat(slug),
229:     };
230:     return { outcome: 'voted', board: nextBoard, rateRecord: nextRate, slug, errors: [] };
231:   }
232: 
233:   // New suggestion path.
234:   if (countSuggestions(safeBoard) >= MAX_SUGGESTIONS) {
235:     return {
236:       outcome: 'full',
237:       board: safeBoard,
238:       rateRecord: safeRate,
239:       slug,
240:       errors: ['The suggestion list is full right now.'],
241:     };
242:   }
243: 
244:   const nextBoard = {
245:     version: safeBoard.version,
246:     suggestions: {
247:       ...safeBoard.suggestions,
248:       [slug]: {
249:         name: validation.name,
250:         votes: 1,
251:         approved: false,
252:         createdAt: now,
253:         updatedAt: now,
254:       },
255:     },
256:   };
257:   const nextRate = {
258:     actions: safeRate.actions + 1,
259:     voted: safeRate.voted.concat(slug),
260:   };
261:   return { outcome: 'pending', board: nextBoard, rateRecord: nextRate, slug, errors: [] };
262: }
263: 
264: /**
265:  * Apply a vote to an existing approved suggestion.
266:  * @param {{
267:  *   board: unknown,
268:  *   slug: unknown,
269:  *   rateRecord: unknown,
270:  *   now: string
271:  * }} options
272:  * @returns {{
273:  *   outcome: 'voted' | 'notFound' | 'notApproved' | 'rateLimited',
274:  *   board: { version: number, suggestions: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> },
275:  *   rateRecord: { actions: number, voted: string[] },
276:  *   errors: string[]
277:  * }}
278:  */
279: export function applyVote(options) {
280:   const { board, slug, rateRecord, now } = options || {};
281:   const safeBoard = normaliseBoard(board);
282:   const safeRate = normaliseRateRecord(rateRecord);
283:   const safeSlug = typeof slug === 'string' ? slug : '';
284: 
285:   if (!safeSlug || !safeBoard.suggestions[safeSlug]) {
286:     return {
287:       outcome: 'notFound',
288:       board: safeBoard,
289:       rateRecord: safeRate,
290:       errors: ['That suggestion is not available.'],
291:     };
292:   }
293: 
294:   const existing = safeBoard.suggestions[safeSlug];
295:   if (!existing.approved) {
296:     return {
297:       outcome: 'notApproved',
298:       board: safeBoard,
299:       rateRecord: safeRate,
300:       errors: ['That suggestion is not approved yet.'],
301:     };
302:   }
303: 
304:   if (!canAct(safeRate).allowed) {
305:     return {
306:       outcome: 'rateLimited',
307:       board: safeBoard,
308:       rateRecord: safeRate,
309:       errors: ['You have reached the daily limit. Try again tomorrow.'],
310:     };
311:   }
312: 
313:   if (!canVote(safeRate, safeSlug).allowed) {
314:     return {
315:       outcome: 'rateLimited',
316:       board: safeBoard,
317:       rateRecord: safeRate,
318:       errors: ['You have already voted for this club today.'],
319:     };
320:   }
321: 
322:   const nextBoard = {
323:     version: safeBoard.version,
324:     suggestions: {
325:       ...safeBoard.suggestions,
326:       [safeSlug]: {
327:         ...existing,
328:         votes: (Number.isInteger(existing.votes) ? existing.votes : 0) + 1,
329:         updatedAt: now,
330:       },
331:     },
332:   };
333:   const nextRate = {
334:     actions: safeRate.actions + 1,
335:     voted: safeRate.voted.concat(safeSlug),
336:   };
337:   return { outcome: 'voted', board: nextBoard, rateRecord: nextRate, errors: [] };
338: }
339: 
340: /**
341:  * Build the public leaderboard. Approved suggestions only, sorted by votes
342:  * descending then name ascending. Timestamps are stripped.
343:  * @param {unknown} board
344:  * @returns {{ suggestions: Array<{ slug: string, name: string, votes: number }> }}
345:  */
346: export function publicView(board) {
347:   const safe = normaliseBoard(board);
348:   const suggestions = Object.entries(safe.suggestions)
349:     .filter(([, value]) => value && value.approved === true)
350:     .map(([slug, value]) => ({
351:       slug,
352:       name: String(value.name || ''),
353:       votes: Number.isInteger(value.votes) ? value.votes : 0,
354:     }));
355:   suggestions.sort((a, b) => {
356:     if (b.votes !== a.votes) return b.votes - a.votes;
357:     return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
358:   });
359:   return { suggestions };
360: }
361: 
362: /**
363:  * Build the admin view. Every suggestion with timestamps, sorted by votes
364:  * descending then name ascending.
365:  * @param {unknown} board
366:  * @returns {{ suggestions: Array<{
367:  *   slug: string, name: string, votes: number, approved: boolean,
368:  *   createdAt: string, updatedAt: string
369:  * }> }}
370:  */
371: export function adminView(board) {
372:   const safe = normaliseBoard(board);
373:   const suggestions = Object.entries(safe.suggestions).map(([slug, value]) => ({
374:     slug,
375:     name: String(value.name || ''),
376:     votes: Number.isInteger(value.votes) ? value.votes : 0,
377:     approved: value.approved === true,
378:     createdAt: String(value.createdAt || ''),
379:     updatedAt: String(value.updatedAt || ''),
380:   }));
381:   suggestions.sort((a, b) => {
382:     if (b.votes !== a.votes) return b.votes - a.votes;
383:     return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
384:   });
385:   return { suggestions };
386: }
387: 
388: /**
389:  * Return the origin when it is in the allowed list, otherwise an empty string.
390:  * Comparison is case sensitive and exact, so trailing slashes matter.
391:  * @param {string} origin
392:  * @param {string} allowedList Comma separated list of allowed origins.
393:  * @returns {string}
394:  */
395: export function pickOrigin(origin, allowedList) {
396:   if (typeof origin !== 'string' || origin.length === 0) return '';
397:   if (typeof allowedList !== 'string' || allowedList.length === 0) return '';
398:   const allowed = allowedList
399:     .split(',')
400:     .map((entry) => entry.trim())
401:     .filter((entry) => entry.length > 0);
402:   return allowed.includes(origin) ? origin : '';
403: }
404: 
405: /**
406:  * Compare two strings in constant time. Returns false when either is not a
407:  * string. Differing lengths return false early, which leaks only the length
408:  * of the admin token, not its content.
409:  * @param {unknown} a
410:  * @param {unknown} b
411:  * @returns {boolean}
412:  */
413: export function constantTimeEquals(a, b) {
414:   if (typeof a !== 'string' || typeof b !== 'string') return false;
415:   if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
416:   let result = 0;
417:   for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i += 1) {
418:     result |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i);
419:   }
420:   return result === 0;
421: }

 8:     "deploy": "wrangler deploy"

================
File: worker/README.md
================
  1: # Roast Room Suggestions Worker
  2: 
  3: Cloudflare Worker that backs the audience participation section on the
  4: landing page: suggestions and voting. Built with plain JavaScript ES modules
  5: and Workers KV. No frameworks.
  6: 
  7: ## Layout
  8: 
  9: ```text
 10: worker/
 11:   package.json
 12:   wrangler.toml
 13:   src/
 14:     index.js    routing and KV access
 15:     logic.js    pure logic, no Cloudflare APIs
 16:   README.md
 17: ```
 18: 
 19: ## Endpoints
 20: 
 21: All responses are JSON encoded as UTF 8. Errors are shaped `{ error, message }`
 22: with no stack traces.
 23: 
 24: | Method | Path | Auth | Purpose |
 25: | --- | --- | --- | --- |
 26: | GET | /api/suggestions | none | Public leaderboard. Approved only, sorted by votes then name, cached for 30 seconds. |
 27: | POST | /api/suggestions | origin | Submit a suggestion or merge into a vote. Body `{ name, website }`. |
 28: | POST | /api/votes | origin | Vote for an approved suggestion. Body `{ slug }`. |
 29: | GET | /api/admin/suggestions | Bearer | Every suggestion with timestamps. |
 30: | POST | /api/admin/approve | Bearer | Body `{ slug, approved }`. |
 31: | POST | /api/admin/remove | Bearer | Body `{ slug }`. |
 32: | OPTIONS | any route | none | CORS preflight, 204. |
 33: 
 34: `Bearer` means the `Authorization` header must equal `Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>` and
 35: the token is compared in constant time. A failed comparison returns 401 with
 36: no detail. An unset `ADMIN_TOKEN` rejects every admin request.
 37: 
 38: An unknown route returns 404 JSON.
 39: 
 40: ## Storage
 41: 
 42: Two kinds of key in the `SUGGESTIONS` namespace.
 43: 
 44: - `board` holds
 45:   `{ version: 1, suggestions: { [slug]: { name, votes, approved, createdAt, updatedAt } } }`.
 46:   The board is capped at 300 suggestions. A full board returns a friendly
 47:   message and writes nothing.
 48: - `rl:<hash>:<YYYYMMDD>` holds `{ actions, voted: [slug] }` for one client per
 49:   UTC day, expiring after 172800 seconds (two days). `hash` is the first 32
 50:   hex characters of `SHA-256(HASH_SALT + CF-Connecting-IP)`. The raw IP
 51:   address is never stored and never logged.
 52: 
 53: Limits:
 54: 
 55: - 6 actions per day per client. Suggestions and votes both count as actions.
 56: - One vote per slug per day per client.
 57: - An accepted action performs exactly two KV writes: the rate record and the
 58:   board. A rejected action performs no writes.
 59: 
 60: The Workers KV free plan allows about 1000 writes per day. Because every
 61: accepted action is two writes, that is about 500 accepted actions per day on
 62: the free plan. Plan accordingly.
 63: 
 64: ## Consistency
 65: 
 66: KV is eventually consistent. Two simultaneous writes can lose a vote. This is
 67: accepted for stage 4. If exact counts ever matter, replace KV with Durable
 68: Objects. Nothing in this Worker depends on exact counts for correctness.
 69: 
 70: ## Origin allow list
 71: 
 72: `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` in `wrangler.toml` is a comma separated string of allowed
 73: origins. A request that carries an `Origin` header not on the list is rejected
 74: with 403 on POST routes and receives no CORS headers on any route. Requests
 75: without an `Origin` header, such as `curl`, are allowed; CSRF protection comes
 76: from the browser sending an `Origin` header on cross origin POSTs.
 77: 
 78: ## Name and slug rules
 79: 
 80: - Trim and collapse runs of whitespace to one space.
 81: - 2 to 40 characters.
 82: - Allowed characters are letters in any language, digits, spaces, apostrophe,
 83:   full stop and ampersand.
 84: - Reject anything containing `http`, `www` or an at sign.
 85: - Reject digits only.
 86: - The slug is lowercase a to z, digits and underscores. Accented letters are
 87:   stripped of diacritics first, so `Atlético` becomes `atletico`.
 88: 
 89: ## Local development
 90: 
 91: ```bash
 92: cd worker
 93: npm install
 94: npx wrangler login
 95: npx wrangler dev
 96: ```
 97: 
 98: `wrangler dev` runs the Worker locally against a development KV namespace.
 99: Replace the `id` placeholder in `wrangler.toml` after you create the real
100: namespace.
101: 
102: ## Deployment
103: 
104: 1. `cd worker`
105: 2. `npm install`
106: 3. `npx wrangler login`
107: 4. `npx wrangler kv namespace create SUGGESTIONS`
108:    Copy the `id` from the output and paste it over the placeholder in
109:    `wrangler.toml`.
110: 5. `npx wrangler secret put ADMIN_TOKEN`
111:    Paste a long random value, for example the output of
112:    `openssl rand -hex 32`. This is the password you type on `adminlab.html`.
113: 6. `npx wrangler secret put HASH_SALT`
114:    Paste another long random value, for example the output of
115:    `openssl rand -hex 32`. This salts the client hash used for rate limiting.
116:    Rotate it only if you accept that rate limits reset for everyone.
117: 7. `npx wrangler deploy`
118:    The output prints the deployed URL, for example
119:    `https://roastroomsuggest.yourname.workers.dev`.
120: 8. Paste that URL into `js/suggest/suggestConfig.js` as `SUGGEST_API_BASE`.
121: 9. Update `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` in `wrangler.toml` with your real site origins,
122:    replacing the Netlify placeholder, and run `npx wrangler deploy` again.
123: 
124: ## Manual smoke test
125: 
126: ```bash
127: # Public leaderboard
128: curl -s https://roastroomsuggest.yourname.workers.dev/api/suggestions
129: 
130: # Submit a suggestion
131: curl -s -X POST \
132:   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
133:   -H "Origin: http://localhost:3000" \
134:   -d '{"name":"Arsenal","website":""}' \
135:   https://roastroomsuggest.yourname.workers.dev/api/suggestions
136: 
137: # Vote
138: curl -s -X POST \
139:   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
140:   -H "Origin: http://localhost:3000" \
141:   -d '{"slug":"arsenal"}' \
142:   https://roastroomsuggest.yourname.workers.dev/api/votes
143: 
144: # Admin list
145: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
146:   https://roastroomsuggest.yourname.workers.dev/api/admin/suggestions
147: 
148: # Admin approve
149: curl -s -X POST \
150:   -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
151:   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
152:   -d '{"slug":"arsenal","approved":true}' \
153:   https://roastroomsuggest.yourname.workers.dev/api/admin/approve
154: 
155: # Wrong origin is blocked
156: curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST \
157:   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
158:   -H "Origin: https://evil.example" \
159:   -d '{"name":"Arsenal","website":""}' \
160:   https://roastroomsuggest.yourname.workers.dev/api/suggestions
161: # Expect 403
162: ```

================
File: worker/wrangler.toml
================
 1: name = "roastroomsuggest"
 2: main = "src/index.js"
 3: compatibility_date = "2025-04-01"
 4: 
 5: [[kv_namespaces]]
 6: binding = "SUGGESTIONS"
 7: id = "c7d1798800ad476598ef3323f31195eb"
 8: 
 9: [vars]
10: # Comma separated list of allowed origins.
11: # Requests with an Origin header that is not on this list are rejected with 403
12: # for POST routes and receive no CORS headers for any route.
13: #
14: # http://localhost:3000              local dev (any dev server on this port)
15: # http://localhost:8000              local dev (python -m http.server)
16: # https://paste_your_netlify_site_here   your Netlify site URL
17: # https://roastroom.fritt.org        production site
18: ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "http://localhost:3000,http://localhost:8000,https://deroastroom.netlify.app/,https://roastroom.fritt.org"

213:                 <span class="w-16 text-xs text-textMuted">space2</span>
214:                 <span class="h-3 rounded-sharp bg-primary" style="width: var(--space2)"></span>

218:                 <span class="w-16 text-xs text-textMuted">space4</span>

264:               <li>slow 320ms</li>

271:       <section aria-labelledby="clubsHeading" class="mb-12">
272:         <h2 id="clubsHeading" class="text-2xl text-text">Clubs</h2>
273:         <p class="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm text-textMuted">
274:           Read from data/clubs.json through the real registry module. The registry is the
275:           single source of truth for which clubs exist.
276:         </p>
277:         <p id="registryStatus" role="status" class="mt-3 text-sm text-accent">
278:           Loading the club registry.
279:         </p>
280: 
281:         <div class="mt-4 grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
282:           <div>
283:             <h3 class="tokenLabel">Live</h3>
284:             <ul id="liveClubs" class="mt-3 space-y-3"></ul>
285:           </div>
286:           <div>
287:             <h3 class="tokenLabel">Coming soon</h3>
288:             <ul id="comingSoonClubs" class="mt-3 space-y-3"></ul>

295:       <div class="mx-auto max-w-5xl px-4 py-10">
296:         <p class="text-sm text-textMuted">
297:           The Roast Room, stage 1 foundations. Built by Fritt. Every claim on the finished
298:           site must be sourced, dated and verified before it can be published.
299:         </p>
300:       </div>
301:     </footer>
302: 
303:     <script type="module">
304:       import { getComingSoonClubs, getLiveClubs, loadClub, loadRegistry } from './js/registry.js';
305:       import { applyTheme } from './js/theme.js';
306: 
307:       const registryStatus = document.getElementById('registryStatus');
308:       const liveClubsList = document.getElementById('liveClubs');
309:       const comingSoonClubsList = document.getElementById('comingSoonClubs');
310:       const themeButton = document.getElementById('themeToggle');
311:       const themeName = document.getElementById('currentTheme');
312:       const overridesEl = document.getElementById('themeOverrides');
313:       const tokenValues = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-token]'));
314: 
315:       const themeCycle = [];
316:       let themeIndex = 0;
317: 
318:       /**
319:        * Read the live value of every colour token and print it under the swatch.
320:        * @returns {void}
321:        */
322:       function refreshTokenValues() {
323:         const styles = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);
324: 
325:         for (const element of tokenValues) {
326:           const variable = element.getAttribute('data-token');
327:           const value = styles.getPropertyValue(variable).trim();
328:           element.textContent = value || 'not set';
329:         }
330:       }
331: 
332:       /**
333:        * Print which tokens the currently applied theme overrides. Because
334:        * applyTheme clears every property before applying a new theme, this list
335:        * is exactly the set of keys in the active theme object.
336:        * @returns {void}
337:        */
338:       function updateOverrideLine() {
339:         if (!overridesEl) return;
340: 
341:         if (themeCycle.length === 0) {
342:           overridesEl.textContent = '';
343:           return;
344:         }
345: 
346:         const current = themeCycle[themeIndex];
347:         const keys = current.theme ? Object.keys(current.theme) : [];
348:         const list = keys.length > 0 ? keys.join(', ') : 'none';
349:         overridesEl.textContent = `Tokens currently overridden by ${current.label}: ${list}`;
350:       }
351: 
352:       /**
353:        * Build one club card for the registry lists.
354:        * @param {Record<string, unknown>} club
355:        * @returns {HTMLLIElement}
356:        */
357:       function createClubItem(club) {
358:         const item = document.createElement('li');
359:         item.className = 'rounded-sharp border border-line bg-surface p-4';
360: 
361:         const name = document.createElement('p');
362:         name.className = 'font-display text-xl uppercase text-text';
363:         name.textContent = String(club.name);
364: 
365:         const meta = document.createElement('p');
366:         meta.className = 'mt-2 text-sm text-textMuted';
367:         meta.textContent = `id: ${club.id} | status: ${club.status} | themeKey: ${club.themeKey}`;
368: 
369:         item.append(name, meta);
370: 
371:         if (typeof club.dataFile === 'string') {
372:           const file = document.createElement('p');
373:           file.className = 'mt-1 text-xs text-textMuted';
374:           file.textContent = `dataFile: ${club.dataFile}`;
375:           item.append(file);
376:         }
377: 
378:         return item;
379:       }
380: 
381:       /**
382:        * Replace the contents of a list with the given clubs.
383:        * @param {HTMLUListElement} list
384:        * @param {Array<Record<string, unknown>>} clubs
385:        * @returns {void}
386:        */
387:       function renderClubList(list, clubs) {
388:         list.textContent = '';
389:         for (const club of clubs) {
390:           list.append(createClubItem(club));
391:         }
392:       }
393: 
394:       /**
395:        * Load the registry and the live club, then wire up the theme button.
396:        * The cycle is deliberately Manchester United, Arsenal, Manchester United.
397:        * @returns {Promise<void>}
398:        */
399:       async function start() {
400:         try {
401:           const registry = await loadRegistry();
402:           renderClubList(liveClubsList, getLiveClubs(registry));
403:           renderClubList(comingSoonClubsList, getComingSoonClubs(registry));
404:           registryStatus.textContent = `Registry version ${registry.version} loaded with ${registry.clubs.length} clubs.`;
405: 
406:           const liveClub = await loadClub('manutd');
407:           themeCycle.push({ label: liveClub.name, theme: liveClub.theme });
408: 
409:           const comingSoonWithTheme = getComingSoonClubs(registry).filter((club) => club.theme);
410:           for (const club of comingSoonWithTheme) {
411:             themeCycle.push({ label: club.name, theme: club.theme });
412:           }
413: 
414:           themeButton.disabled = themeCycle.length < 2;
415:         } catch (error) {
416:           registryStatus.textContent =
417:             'Could not load the club registry. Serve the site over http, for example with npx serve, then reload. ' +
418:             String(error.message);
419:         }
420: 
421:         refreshTokenValues();
422:         updateOverrideLine();
423:       }
424: 
425:       themeButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
426:         if (themeCycle.length === 0) return;
427: 
428:         themeIndex = (themeIndex + 1) % themeCycle.length;
429:         const next = themeCycle[themeIndex];
430: 
431:         applyTheme(next.theme);
432:         themeName.textContent = next.label;
433:         refreshTokenValues();
434:         updateOverrideLine();
435:       });
436: 
437:       await start();
438:     </script>
439:   </body>
440: </html>

================
File: js/pages/room.js
================
  1: /**
  2:  * Roast room logic.
  3:  * Reads the club id from the query string, loads the club, wires the category
  4:  * filter and the shuffle bag, and shows roasts on demand with a short reel.
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: import { CLUB_STATUS, DEFAULT_CLUB_ID } from '../config.js';
  8: import { loadClub, loadRegistry } from '../registry.js';
  9: import { applyTheme } from '../theme.js';
 10: import { buildCategoryFilter } from '../ui/categoryFilter.js';
 11: import { createRoastCard } from '../ui/roastCard.js';
 12: import { createShuffleBag } from '../ui/shuffleBag.js';
 13: import { revealRoast } from '../ui/reveal.js';
 14: import { clear, prefersReducedMotion } from '../utils/dom.js';
 15: import { parseRoastHash } from '../utils/links.js';
 16: import { createSharePanel } from '../share/sharePanel.js';
 17: 
 18: const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
 19: const clubIdParam = params.get('club') || DEFAULT_CLUB_ID;
 20: 
 21: const loadingEl = document.getElementById('loadingState');
 22: const errorEl = document.getElementById('errorState');
 23: const errorMessageEl = document.getElementById('errorMessage');
 24: const roomEl = document.getElementById('roomState');
 25: const filterContainer = document.getElementById('categoryFilter');
 26: const roastButton = document.getElementById('roastButton');
 27: const progressEl = document.getElementById('progress');
 28: const roastContainer = document.getElementById('roastContainer');
 29: const clubBadge = document.getElementById('clubBadge');
 30: const emptyEl = document.getElementById('emptyState');
 31: const liveRegion = document.getElementById('roastLiveRegion');
 32: const pageHeading = document.getElementById('pageHeading');
 33: const sharePanelEl = document.getElementById('sharePanel');
 34: 
 35: /** @type {Record<string, unknown> | null} */
 36: let club = null;
 37: let selectedCategory = 'all';
 38: /** @type {ReturnType<typeof createShuffleBag> | null} */
 39: let bag = null;
 40: /** @type {Record<string, unknown> | null} */
 41: let currentRoast = null;
 42: let busy = false;
 43: /** @type {ReturnType<typeof createSharePanel> | null} */
 44: let sharePanel = null;
 45: 
 46: function showLoading() {
 47:   if (loadingEl) loadingEl.classList.remove('hidden');
 48:   if (errorEl) errorEl.classList.add('hidden');
 49:   if (roomEl) roomEl.classList.add('hidden');
 50: }
 51: 
 52: /**
 53:  * Show the error state with a friendly message.
 54:  * @param {string} message
 55:  * @returns {void}
 56:  */
 57: function showError(message) {
 58:   if (loadingEl) loadingEl.classList.add('hidden');
 59:   if (roomEl) roomEl.classList.add('hidden');
 60:   if (errorEl) errorEl.classList.remove('hidden');
 61:   if (errorMessageEl) errorMessageEl.textContent = message;
 62:   if (clubBadge) clubBadge.textContent = 'Club unavailable';
 63: }
 64: 
 65: function showRoom() {
 66:   if (loadingEl) loadingEl.classList.add('hidden');
 67:   if (errorEl) errorEl.classList.add('hidden');
 68:   if (roomEl) roomEl.classList.remove('hidden');
 69: }
 70: 
 71: /**
 72:  * Roasts in the current filter.
 73:  * @returns {Array<Record<string, unknown>>}
 74:  */
 75: function getFilteredRoasts() {
 76:   if (!club) return [];
 77:   const roasts = Array.isArray(club.roasts) ? club.roasts : [];
 78:   if (selectedCategory === 'all') return roasts;
 79:   return roasts.filter((roast) => roast.category === selectedCategory);
 80: }
 81: 
 82: /**
 83:  * Update the "Roast N of M" line. Nothing is shown before the first serve or
 84:  * when the current cycle has already served everything once.
 85:  * @returns {void}
 86:  */
 87: function updateProgress() {
 88:   if (!progressEl) return;
 89:   if (!bag || !currentRoast || bag.size() === 0) {
 90:     progressEl.textContent = '';
 91:     return;
 92:   }
 93:   const size = bag.size();
 94:   const remaining = bag.remaining();
 95:   const n = size - remaining;
 96:   if (n <= 0) {
 97:     progressEl.textContent = '';
 98:     return;
 99:   }
100:   progressEl.textContent = `Roast ${n} of ${size}`;
101: }
102: 
103: /**
104:  * Look up the category metadata for a roast.
105:  * @param {string} id
106:  * @returns {Record<string, unknown> | null}
107:  */
108: function findCategory(id) {
109:   if (!club || !Array.isArray(club.categories)) return null;
110:   return club.categories.find((category) => category && category.id === id) || null;
111: }
112: 
113: /**
114:  * Show a roast in the card area, reveal it, announce it and update the URL hash.
115:  * @param {Record<string, unknown>} roast
116:  * @param {{ animate?: boolean }} [options]
117:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
118:  */
119: async function showRoast(roast, options = {}) {
120:   if (!roast || !roastContainer) return;
121: 
122:   const shouldAnimate = options.animate !== false;
123:   currentRoast = roast;
124: 
125:   const category = findCategory(String(roast.category));
126:   const built = createRoastCard(roast, category);
127: 
128:   clear(roastContainer);
129:   roastContainer.append(built.element);
130: 
131:   const base = window.location.pathname + window.location.search;
132:   try {
133:     window.history.replaceState(null, '', `${base}#${encodeURIComponent(String(roast.id))}`);
134:   } catch {
135:     // Ignore history errors, the page still works.
136:   }
137: 
138:   const animate = shouldAnimate && !prefersReducedMotion();
139: 
140:   if (animate) {
141:     const pool = (Array.isArray(club?.roasts) ? club.roasts : [])
142:       .map((entry) => String(entry.headline))
143:       .filter((headline) => headline.length > 0);
144:     await revealRoast({
145:       headlineElement: built.headlineElement,
146:       finalHeadline: String(roast.headline),
147:       reelPool: pool,
148:       hiddenElements: built.hiddenElements,
149:     });
150:   } else {
151:     built.headlineElement.textContent = String(roast.headline);
152:     for (const el of built.hiddenElements) {
153:       el.classList.add('isVisible');
154:     }
155:   }
156: 
157:   if (liveRegion) {
158:     liveRegion.textContent = String(roast.headline);
159:   }
160: 
161:   if (sharePanel) {
162:     try {
163:       sharePanel.update(roast, category, club);
164:     } catch (error) {
165:       console.warn('[roastRoom] could not update the share panel', error);
166:     }
167:   }
168: 
169:   updateProgress();
170: }
171: 
172: /**
173:  * Rebuild the bag and the filter chips for the current selection.
174:  * @returns {void}
175:  */
176: function rebuildBagAndFilter() {
177:   if (!club) return;
178: 
179:   const filtered = getFilteredRoasts();
180: 
181:   if (bag) {
182:     bag.reset(filtered);
183:   } else {
184:     bag = createShuffleBag(filtered);
185:   }
186: 
187:   if (filterContainer) {
188:     buildCategoryFilter({
189:       container: filterContainer,
190:       categories: Array.isArray(club.categories) ? club.categories : [],
191:       roasts: Array.isArray(club.roasts) ? club.roasts : [],
192:       selectedId: selectedCategory,
193:       onChange: handleFilterChange,
194:     });
195:   }
196: 
197:   const isEmpty = filtered.length === 0;
198:   if (roastButton) roastButton.disabled = isEmpty;
199:   if (emptyEl) emptyEl.classList.toggle('hidden', !isEmpty);
200: 
201:   if (isEmpty) {
202:     clear(roastContainer);
203:     currentRoast = null;
204:     if (progressEl) progressEl.textContent = '';
205:     if (sharePanel) sharePanel.hide();
206:   }
207: }
208: 
209: /**
210:  * Handle a filter chip click. Resets the current roast and the bag.
211:  * @param {string} newId
212:  * @returns {void}
213:  */
214: function handleFilterChange(newId) {
215:   if (busy) return;
216:   selectedCategory = newId;
217:   currentRoast = null;
218:   if (roastContainer) clear(roastContainer);
219:   if (liveRegion) liveRegion.textContent = '';
220:   if (sharePanel) sharePanel.hide();
221:   rebuildBagAndFilter();
222: }
223: 
224: /**
225:  * Handle the Roast them button click.
226:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
227:  */
228: async function handleRoastClick() {
229:   if (busy || !bag) return;
230:   const items = getFilteredRoasts();
231:   if (items.length === 0) return;
232: 
233:   busy = true;
234:   if (roastButton) roastButton.disabled = true;
235: 
236:   try {
237:     const roast = bag.next();
238:     if (roast) {
239:       await showRoast(roast, { animate: true });
240:     }
241:   } finally {
242:     busy = false;
243:     if (roastButton) {
244:       roastButton.disabled = getFilteredRoasts().length === 0;
245:     }
246:   }
247: }
248: 
249: /**
250:  * Boot the page. Reads the club id, loads the club, wires everything up.
251:  * @returns {Promise<void>}
252:  */
253: async function init() {
254:   showLoading();
255: 
256:   try {
257:     const registry = await loadRegistry();
258:     const clubs = Array.isArray(registry.clubs) ? registry.clubs : [];
259:     const entry = clubs.find((candidate) => candidate && candidate.id === clubIdParam);
260: 
261:     if (!entry) {
262:       showError(`That club isn't in the registry. Pick one from the picker instead.`);
263:       return;
264:     }
265: 
266:     if (entry.status !== CLUB_STATUS.LIVE) {
267:       showError(`${entry.name} is coming soon. There isn't a roast room for it yet.`);
268:       return;
269:     }
270: 
271:     club = await loadClub(clubIdParam);
272:     applyTheme(club.theme || {});
273: 
274:     if (clubBadge) clubBadge.textContent = String(club.name || 'Roast Room');
275:     if (pageHeading) pageHeading.textContent = `${club.name || 'Roast Room'} Roast Room`;
276:     document.title = `${club.shortName || club.name || 'Roast Room'} Roast Room | The Roast Room`;
277: 
278:     const hash = parseRoastHash(window.location.hash);
279:     const deepRoast =
280:       hash && Array.isArray(club.roasts)
281:         ? club.roasts.find((roast) => roast && roast.id === hash) || null
282:         : null;
283: 
284:     selectedCategory = 'all';
285:     rebuildBagAndFilter();
286:     showRoom();
287: 
288:     if (sharePanelEl && !sharePanel) {
289:       try {
290:         sharePanel = createSharePanel({ container: sharePanelEl });
291:       } catch (error) {
292:         console.warn('[roastRoom] could not create the share panel', error);
293:       }
294:     }
295: 
296:     if (deepRoast) {
297:       await showRoast(deepRoast, { animate: false });
298:     }
299: 
300:     if (roastButton) {
301:       roastButton.addEventListener('click', handleRoastClick);
302:     }
303:   } catch (error) {
304:     console.warn('[roastRoom] could not open the roast room', error);
305:     showError('We could not load this club. Please try again in a moment.');
306:   }
307: }
308: 
309: init();

================
File: js/share/sharePanel.js

  1: /**
  2:  * Builds and controls the share panel for one roast.
  3:  */
  4: 
  5: import { CARD_FORMATS } from './cardFormats.js';
  6: import { SHARE_HOST_OVERRIDE } from './shareConfig.js';
  7: import { renderRoastCard } from './renderCard.js';
  8: import { absoluteRoastUrl, buildFileName, buildShareText, hostLabel } from './shareText.js';
  9: import { canvasToBlob, copyText, downloadBlob, shareImage } from './actions.js';
 10: import { clear, createElement } from '../utils/dom.js';
 11: 
 12: /**
 13:  * Create the share panel inside a container.
 14:  * @param {{ container: HTMLElement }} options Panel options.
 15:  * @returns {{
 16:  *   update: (roast: Record<string, unknown>, category: Record<string, unknown> | null, club: Record<string, unknown>) => void,
 17:  *   hide: () => void,
 18:  *   show: () => void
 19:  * }} Panel controller.
 20:  */
 21: export function createSharePanel(options) {
 22:   const container = options && options.container ? options.container : null;
 23: 
 24:   if (!container || typeof document === 'undefined') {
 25:     return {
 26:       update() {},
 27:       hide() {},
 28:       show() {},
 29:     };
 30:   }
 31: 
 32:   clear(container);
 33: 
 34:   const heading = createElement('h2', {
 35:     className: 'sharePanelHeading',
 36:     text: 'Share this roast',
 37:     attrs: { id: 'sharePanelHeading' },
 38:   });
 39: 
 40:   const formatToggle = createElement('div', {
 41:     className: 'shareFormatToggle',
 42:     attrs: {
 43:       role: 'group',
 44:       'aria-label': 'Card format',
 45:     },
 46:   });
 47: 
 48:   /** @type {Map<string, HTMLButtonElement>} */
 49:   const formatButtons = new Map();
 50: 
 51:   for (const format of Object.values(CARD_FORMATS)) {
 52:     const button = createElement('button', {
 53:       className: 'shareFormatButton',
 54:       text: format.label,
 55:       attrs: {
 56:         type: 'button',
 57:         'aria-pressed': format.id === 'post' ? 'true' : 'false',
 58:       },
 59:     });
 60:     button.addEventListener('click', () => {
 61:       currentFormatId = format.id;
 62:       updatePressed();
 63:       hideFallback();
 64:       setStatus('');
 65:       schedulePreview();
 66:     });
 67:     formatButtons.set(format.id, button);
 68:     formatToggle.append(button);
 69:   }
 70: 
 71:   const previewWrap = createElement('div', { className: 'sharePreviewWrap' });
 72:   const previewCanvas = createElement('canvas', {
 73:     className: 'sharePreviewCanvas',
 74:     attrs: {
 75:       role: 'img',
 76:       'aria-label': 'Roast card preview',
 77:     },
 78:   });
 79:   previewWrap.append(previewCanvas);
 80: 
 81:   const actions = createElement('div', { className: 'shareActions' });
 82: 
 83:   const shareButton = createElement('button', {
 84:     className: 'shareActionPrimary',
 85:     text: 'Share',
 86:     attrs: { type: 'button' },
 87:   });
 88: 
 89:   const downloadButton = createElement('button', {
 90:     className: 'shareActionSecondary',
 91:     text: 'Download image',
 92:     attrs: { type: 'button' },
 93:   });
 94: 
 95:   const copyButton = createElement('button', {
 96:     className: 'shareActionSecondary',
 97:     text: 'Copy link',
 98:     attrs: { type: 'button' },
 99:   });
100: 
101:   actions.append(shareButton, downloadButton, copyButton);
102: 
103:   const status = createElement('p', {
104:     className: 'shareStatus',
105:     attrs: {
106:       role: 'status',
107:       'aria-live': 'polite',
108:     },
109:   });
110: 
111:   const fallback = createElement('div', { className: 'shareFallback hidden' });
112:   const fallbackLabel = createElement('label', {
113:     className: 'tokenLabel',
114:     text: 'Copy this link',
115:     attrs: { for: 'shareFallbackInput' },
116:   });
117:   const fallbackInput = createElement('input', {
118:     className: 'shareFallbackInput',
119:     attrs: {
120:       id: 'shareFallbackInput',
121:       type: 'text',
122:       readonly: 'readonly',
123:       'aria-label': 'Roast link',
124:     },
125:   });
126:   fallback.append(fallbackLabel, fallbackInput);
127: 
128:   container.append(heading, formatToggle, previewWrap, actions, status, fallback);
129:   container.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', 'sharePanelHeading');
130: 
131:   if (typeof navigator === 'undefined' || typeof navigator.share !== 'function') {
132:     shareButton.hidden = true;
133:   }
134: 
135:   const workCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
136: 
137:   let currentRoast = null;
138:   let currentCategory = null;
139:   let currentClub = null;
140:   let currentFormatId = 'post';
141:   let visible = false;
142:   let lastKey = '';
143:   let cachedBlob = null;
144:   let renderBusy = false;
145:   let renderPending = false;
146: 
147:   /**
148:    * Set the live status message.
149:    * @param {string} message Status text.
150:    * @returns {void}
151:    */
152:   function setStatus(message) {
153:     status.textContent = message || '';
154:   }
155: 
156:   /**
157:    * Hide the copy fallback input.
158:    * @returns {void}
159:    */
160:   function hideFallback() {
161:     fallback.classList.add('hidden');
162:   }
163: 
164:   /**
165:    * Update the format button pressed state.
166:    * @returns {void}
167:    */
168:   function updatePressed() {
169:     for (const [id, button] of formatButtons) {
170:       button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', id === currentFormatId ? 'true' : 'false');
171:     }
172:   }
173: 
174:   /**
175:    * Return the selected format.
176:    * @returns {{ id: string, label: string, width: number, height: number, safeTop: number, safeBottom: number }} Format.
177:    */
178:   function currentFormat() {
179:     return CARD_FORMATS[currentFormatId] || CARD_FORMATS.post;
180:   }
181: 
182:   /**
183:    * Build the absolute roast URL.
184:    * @returns {string} Absolute URL.
185:    */
186:   function currentUrl() {
187:     if (!currentRoast || !currentClub) return '';
188:     return absoluteRoastUrl(window.location.href, currentClub.id, currentRoast.id);
189:   }
190: 
191:   /**
192:    * Draw the preview once.
193:    * @returns {Promise<void>}
194:    */
195:   async function drawPreview() {
196:     if (!visible || !currentRoast || !currentClub) return;
197: 
198:     const roast = currentRoast;
199:     const category = currentCategory;
200:     const club = currentClub;
201:     const format = currentFormat();
202:     const host = hostLabel(window.location.host, SHARE_HOST_OVERRIDE);
203:     const key = `${club.id}|${roast.id}|${format.id}|${host}`;
204: 
205:     if (
206:       key === lastKey &&
207:       previewCanvas.width === format.width &&
208:       previewCanvas.height === format.height
209:     ) {
210:       return;
211:     }
212: 
213:     lastKey = key;
214:     cachedBlob = null;
215:     setStatus('Preparing image');
216: 
217:     const result = await renderRoastCard({
218:       canvas: workCanvas,
219:       roast,
220:       category,
221:       club,
222:       format,
223:       host,
224:     });
225: 
226:     if (!visible) return;
227: 
228:     previewCanvas.width = workCanvas.width;
229:     previewCanvas.height = workCanvas.height;
230: 
231:     const ctx = previewCanvas.getContext('2d');
232:     if (ctx) {
233:       ctx.drawImage(workCanvas, 0, 0);
234:     }
235: 
236:     previewCanvas.setAttribute('role', 'img');
237:     previewCanvas.setAttribute(
238:       'aria-label',
239:       `Roast card preview for ${String(roast.headline || '')} in ${format.label} format`
240:     );
241: 
242:     if (result.truncated) {const renderedKey = key;
243:     canvasToBlob(previewCanvas).then((blobResult) => {
244:       if (blobResult.ok && lastKey === renderedKey) {
245:         cachedBlob = blobResult.blob;
246:       }
247:     });
248:     } else {
249:       setStatus('Preview ready');
250:     }
251:   }
252: 
253:   /**
254:    * Render the preview when the panel is visible.
255:    * @returns {Promise<void>}
256:    */
257:   async function renderPreview() {
258:     if (!visible || !currentRoast || !currentClub) return;
259: 
260:     if (renderBusy) {
261:       renderPending = true;
262:       return;
263:     }
264: 
265:     renderBusy = true;
266: 
267:     try {
268:       do {
269:         renderPending = false;
270:         await drawPreview();
271:       } while (renderPending && visible);
272:     } catch {
273:       setStatus('Could not prepare the image. Try again.');
274:     } finally {
275:       renderBusy = false;
276:     }
277:   }
278: 
279:   /**
280:    * Schedule a preview render.
281:    * @returns {void}
282:    */
283:   function schedulePreview() {
284:     if (!visible) return;
285:     renderPreview().catch(() => {
286:       setStatus('Could not prepare the image. Try again.');
287:     });
288:   }
289: 
290:   /**
291:    * Handle the Share button.
292:    * @returns {Promise<void>}
293:    */
294:   async function handleShare() {
295:     try {
296:       if (!currentRoast || !currentClub) return;
297:       if (!cachedBlob) {
298:         setStatus('The image is still being prepared. Try again in a second.');
299:         return;
300:       }
301: 
302:       const fileName = buildFileName(currentClub.id, currentRoast.id, currentFormat().id);
303:       const url = currentUrl();
304:       const text = buildShareText(currentRoast, url);
305:       const result = await shareImage({
306:         blob: cachedBlob,
307:         fileName,
308:         title: 'The Roast Room',
309:         text,
310:         url,
311:       });
312: 
313:       if (result.ok) {
314:         setStatus('Shared');
315:       } else if (result.reason === 'cancelled') {
316:         setStatus('Share cancelled');
317:       } else if (result.reason === 'unsupported') {
318:         setStatus('Sharing is not available here. Use Download image instead.');
319:       } else {
320:         setStatus('Could not share. Try Download image instead.');
321:       }
322:     } catch {
323:       setStatus('Could not share. Try Download image instead.');
324:     }
325:   }
326: 
327:   /**
328:    * Handle the Download image button.
329:    * @returns {Promise<void>}
330:    */
331:   async function handleDownload() {
332:     try {
333:       if (!currentRoast || !currentClub) return;
334: 
335:       const blobResult = await canvasToBlob(previewCanvas);
336:       if (!blobResult.ok) {
337:         setStatus('Could not save the image. Use Share on your phone instead.');
338:         return;
339:       }
340: 
341:       const fileName = buildFileName(currentClub.id, currentRoast.id, currentFormat().id);
342:       const result = downloadBlob(blobResult.blob, fileName);
343: 
344:       if (result.ok) {
345:         setStatus('Image saved');
346:       } else {
347:         setStatus('Could not save the image. Use Share on your phone instead.');
348:       }
349:     } catch {
350:       setStatus('Could not save the image. Use Share on your phone instead.');
351:     }
352:   }
353: 
354:   /**
355:    * Handle the Copy link button.
356:    * @returns {Promise<void>}
357:    */
358:   async function handleCopy() {
359:     try {
360:       const url = currentUrl();
361:       if (!url) return;
362: 
363:       const result = await copyText(url);
364: 
365:       if (result.ok) {
366:         setStatus('Link copied');
367:         hideFallback();
368:         return;
369:       }
370: 
371:       setStatus('Could not copy, select the link below');
372:       fallbackInput.value = url;
373:       fallback.classList.remove('hidden');
374:       fallbackInput.focus();
375:       fallbackInput.select();
376:       fallbackInput.setSelectionRange(0, fallbackInput.value.length);
377:     } catch {
378:       setStatus('Could not copy, select the link below');
379:       const url = currentUrl();
380:       fallbackInput.value = url;
381:       fallback.classList.remove('hidden');
382:       fallbackInput.focus();
383:       fallbackInput.select();
384:     }
385:   }
386: 
387:   shareButton.addEventListener('click', handleShare);
388:   downloadButton.addEventListener('click', handleDownload);
389:   copyButton.addEventListener('click', handleCopy);
390: 
391:   /**
392:    * Show the panel.
393:    * @returns {void}
394:    */
395:   function show() {
396:     visible = true;
397:     container.classList.remove('hidden');
398:     container.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
399:     schedulePreview();
400:   }
401: 
402:   /**
403:    * Hide the panel.
404:    * @returns {void}
405:    */
406:   function hide() {
407:     visible = false;
408:     container.classList.add('hidden');
409:     container.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
410:     hideFallback();
411:     setStatus('');
412:   }
413: 
414:   /**
415:    * Update the panel for a roast.
416:    * @param {Record<string, unknown>} roast Roast data.
417:    * @param {Record<string, unknown> | null} category Category metadata.
418:    * @param {Record<string, unknown>} club Club data.
419:    * @returns {void}
420:    */
421:   function update(roast, category, club) {
422:     if (!roast || !club) {
423:       hide();
424:       return;
425:     }
426: 
427:     currentRoast = roast;
428:     currentCategory = category;
429:     currentClub = club;
430:     hideFallback();
431:     setStatus('');
432:     updatePressed();
433:     show();
434:   }
435: 
436:   updatePressed();
437: 
438:   return { update, hide, show };
439: }

File: tailwind.config.js

  1: /**
  2:  * Tailwind reads its colour, type, spacing, radius, shadow, z index and motion
  3:  * scales straight from the CSS custom properties in css/tokens.css. That is
  4:  * what lets a club theme swap without a rebuild or a class change.
  5:  */
  6: 
  7: const colors = {
  8:   transparent: 'transparent',
  9:   current: 'currentColor',
 10:   inherit: 'inherit',
 11:   white: '#FFFFFF',
 12:   black: '#000000',
 13:   background: 'var(--colorBackground)',
 14:   surface: 'var(--colorSurface)',
 15:   surfaceRaised: 'var(--colorSurfaceRaised)',
 16:   line: 'var(--colorLine)',
 17:   text: 'var(--colorText)',
 18:   textMuted: 'var(--colorTextMuted)',
 19:   primary: 'var(--colorPrimary)',
 20:   primaryContrast: 'var(--colorPrimaryContrast)',
 21:   accent: 'var(--colorAccent)',
 22: };

================
File: README.md
================
 1: # The Roast Room
 2: 
 3: The Roast Room is an interactive football banter site. Supporters pick a rival club and
 4: read funny, embarrassing and painful facts about it. Every published roast is backed by
 5: dated evidence that a human has checked.
 6: 
 7: The site launches with Manchester United live. Arsenal, Liverpool, Manchester City,
 8: Chelsea and Tottenham Hotspur are listed as coming soon.
 9: 
10: It is built by the solo web agency Fritt and doubles as a portfolio piece, so the code is
11: kept small, readable and easy to extend.
12: 
13: ## Project status
14: 
15: - **Stage 1 (foundations)**: done. Design tokens, theming, club registry, roast schema,
16:   validation, developer token preview, documentation.
17: - **Stage 2 (public pages)**: done. Landing page, club picker, roast generator, shuffle
18:   bag, reveal animation, deep links, category filter, share ready roast URL helper.
19: - **Stage 3 (share cards)**: done. Branded roast cards, Post and Story formats, canvas
20:   rendering, system Share, Download image, Copy link, copy fallback, Card lab QA page,
21:   tests.
22: - **Stage 4 (next)**: suggestions form and Worker.
23: - **Stage 5**: branding polish and deployment.
24: 
25: ## Pages
26: 
27: | Page | Purpose |
28: | --- | --- |
29: | `index.html` | Public landing page. Hero, recent roast ticker, how it works, club picker. |
30: | `room.html?club=<id>` | Roast generator for one live club. Category filter, shuffle bag, roast card with receipts, share panel. |
31: | `tokens.html` | Developer preview of design tokens and theming. Not linked from public pages. |
32: | `cardlab.html` | Developer only QA page for share cards. Not linked from public pages. |
33: 
34: ## Files added in stage 3
35: 
36: ```text
37: js/share/shareConfig.js      Share host override
38: js/share/cardFormats.js      Post and Story card dimensions
39: js/share/textLayout.js       Pure wrap, truncate and fit logic
40: js/share/shareText.js        Share text, file name and absolute URL helpers
41: js/share/renderCard.js       Canvas 2D roast card renderer
42: js/share/actions.js          Blob, download, share and clipboard actions
43: js/share/sharePanel.js       Share panel controller
44: js/dev/cardLab.js            Card lab logic
45: cardlab.html                 Developer only QA page
46: tests/shareText.test.mjs     Tests for pure share logic

 1: {
 2:   "name": "theroastroom",

 5:   "description": "The Roast Room, a football banter site built by Fritt. Stage 3: branded share cards, download and share actions.",
 6:   "type": "module",
